records.title: Drones for Smart Agriculture
records.description: CIC PLC launched an innovation which involves the use of agriculture drones for “smart agriculture practices,” such as scanning fields and distributing agro chemicals and fertilizer with minimum human involvement and wastage. Under this initiative, CIC has developed a technology to scan weeds in large paddy fields using battery powered drones (planes) and spray chemicals to them using the drone. To succeed in the effort, the company used studies and research for the past 8 years to introduce this novel technology which would also minimize the use of chemicals and minimize environmental impact.

records.title: Cropwiz
records.description: Cropwiz, one of the Sri Lanka’s largest agriculture project to be resilient to seasonal weather patterns, is one such futuristic investment, which indicates the potential for protected agriculture at a time where changing weather patterns are wreaking havoc on the country’s agriculture and food production. The project, with an investment of approximately Rs. 1 billion – is an international Joint Venture and employs cutting-edge greenhouse technology which enables ‘climate smart,’ year-round production, mitigating impact of climate change. The project employs automated climate control and fertigation systems, as well as hydroponics.  The greenhouses are envisaged to be largely self-sufficient and sustainable in terms of water requirement – through the use of a rainwater harvesting water reservoir and state of the art techniques resulting in near-zero water wastage.

_annotations.Digital Solution Type (Category & sub-ca: Digital Agriculture :: Urban agriculture, indoor farming
_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di: Farming communities are provided training and expertise (more than 13,400 farmers benefited in Moneragala and Anuradhapura areas).

Two plants with a total dryer and storage capacity of 32,000 MT constructed and operational

Farming communities are provided training and expertise (more than 13,400 farmers benefited in Moneragala and Anuradhapura areas). 

Safer inputs in the production of poultry feeds via the application of proper drying techniques

records.title: “Govi Mithuru”/”Uzhavar Thozhan” (“farmer’s friend”)
records.description: Dialog’s pioneering direct-to-consumer agricultural value added service (Agri VAS), “Govi Mithuru”/”Uzhavar Thozhan” (“farmer’s friend”), today provides over 600,000 farmers with advice on farming best practices across multiple crops. The application provides customized and timely advice to farmers regarding land preparation, cultivation, crop protection, harvest and improved family nutrition. Content contributors include the Ministry of Agriculture of the Government of Sri Lanka, the Centre for Agriculture and Biosciences International (CABI), and the Ministry of Health, Nutrition & Indigenous Medicine of the Government of Sri Lanka (nutrition information). This service is specially designed to help farmers by sending the right Information at the right time for each farmer's needs, correctly tailored for their crop, location and stage of cultivation. Registered users receive information related to each registered crop as a voice message to their mobile phones. Users have unlimited free access to call 616 to listen to all messages received up to that point.

records.title: Boga Purokathanaya (Early Warning)
records.description: This mobile app serves as an early warning solution. Crop need definite time period from field establishment to harvesting. Area under cultivation determine the supply and market condition at harvesting stage and it lead to price fluctuation. It provides information about the field condition at the decision making stage of field establishment and forecast market information at harvesting stage to assist farmers in easy decision making. This ensures farmer income by controlling price drop and consumer satisfaction by minimizing increasing of price level which are ultimate objectives of this mobile application.

records.title: Krushi Advisor
records.description: “Krushi Advisor” mobile app is an Android version agriculture mobile app providing agricultural advisory services for food crop cultivation, latest agricultural technology, acts and regulations and agriculture related service providers with their contact details in Sri Lanka. The “Krushi Advisor” is an offline mobile app that can be used when there is limited access to internet facilit (both in online and offline modes). The target group of this mobile app considers farmers, agriculture entrepreneurs, students and other agriculture information seeking stakeholders. This app provides advisory on suitable cultivation location, available varieties with seed and planting material requirement, field establishment with nursery management, fertilizer recommendation, water management, weed management, pest management, disease management, nutrient deficiency and physical disorders, harvesting and post harvesting and special crop management systems available for selected food crop by user. The significant facility of this app is the ability to contact 1920 agricultural advisory service at any time by users.

records.title: Coconut App
records.description: Developed by the Coconut Cultivation Board, this mobile application provides information on various field activities related to coconut cultivation, various diseases and pest control methods, services provided by Coconut Cultivation Board and expenses about all the field activities related to coconut cultivation to coconut growers through several packages. In addition, the coconut grower can watch some short videos for further information on diseases and pests related to coconut cultivation. This online and offline mode application also facilitates the grower to register and obtain services provided by the Coconut Cultivation Board, gather information about the places by which necessary inputs can be purchased and directions to those places. Coconut growers can submit the issues encountered at the field related to coconut cultivation in words, as a voice message, picture or a video tape and obtain the assistance of relevant technical officers with immediate effect.

records.title: Weather Index Insurance (WII)
records.description: IWMI introduced an application to the farmer community (pilot in Dunumadalawa, Ellawewa GND) in order that they may be informed of weather patterns before undertaking any agricultural activities. IWMI has installed two measurements at a central location in the village, to measure and forecast rainfall and temperature. This information is sent to the Farmers mobile phone every two weeks. The agro-economic advisories prepared in collaboration with the Department of Agrarian Development are also sent to the Farmers mobile phone. The weather insurance product is very specific to the area, the season, crop and risk insured. A compensation for the decreased revenue from cultivation of the specified crop due to excess or deficit in rainfall in the specified location is made to the farmers who obtained the respective insurance policy. The compensation would be based on the variation between the Weather Index set and the Actual Observed Index recorded in the village. The crop period is divided into three Cover Phases (months) considering the different level of rainfall required in each phase.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di: Galebindunuwewa - Approx. 10% of the farmers. Ellawewa - This product was first piloted in 2021 with maize farmers in the village of Dunumadalawa, Ellawewa GN Division at Anuradhapura District. Over 150 farmers at Dunumadalawa are registered with IWMI on this application. However. The Agriculture Inspector only heard about the app recently and didn't have a full understanding of the tech. Later, this App was also piloted in Ampara, Monaragala, Vavuniya, Kurunegala, and Hambantota Districts.
_annotations.Digital Solution Geographic scope (Enter: Galebindunuwewa and Ellawewa. Also piloted in Ampara, Monaragala, Vavuniya, Kurunegala, and Hambantota Districts.

records.title: Canned Fish Online Marketing System
records.description: TESS has its own online marketing system to source small fish for the canning process. In order to move away from the old system where the fishermen would call the company at 5.00am every morning to negotiate price based on catch, TESS decided to implement a SMS system. The fishermen have been requested to send a SMS with the price, fish load number, catch, weight details etc. so that when it is unloaded at TESS factory/centre all the details can be checked and verified. However, there are some limitations, where for instance the ice may be included in weight, some fishermen are not familiar with SMS and some don't have bank accounts for payment transfers.

_annotations.Digital Solution Type (Category & sub-ca: Digital Agrifood Services :: Digital marketing and trading

records.title: Fish Forecasting for Tuna
records.description: Utilising 3 types of data - satellite data (from NASA), oceanography data and fisheries log book data - a fishing ground advisory (forecast) is developed and provided to the fishermen all around Sri Lanka, targeting fishermen for Yellow Fin Tuna and Skip Jack Tuna (more recently). The data includes sea temperature, currents of the oceans, small organisms, and previous catch information and this is used to predict fishing grounds. The main objective of the technology is to minimise the fishermen's sea time (as they stay for 10 to 30 days) and increase efficiency. The remote sensing application is targeted towards boat owners, skipper, and fisherman that owns the boat. The information comes to the Harbour office from the Department of Fisheries, however this is not communicated to the fishermen directly from the harbour office. Fishermen mentioned that they receive tuna forecasting information daily, and the information is shared with the boats through radio.

_annotations.Name of supplier/developer: The National Aquatic Resources Research and Development Agency (NARA)
_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di: Previously, fishing ground advisory information was provided once a week, but now NARA tries to make it available 3 times a week. This information targets Yellow Fin Tuna fishermen mainly in Negombo, Dickovita, Mirissa, Devinuwara, and Dickwella, and more recently Skip Jack Tuna Fishermen. The information is disseminated through WhatsApp groups (2 groups, 400 persons), email and the NARA Facebook page. According to radio officer at Nilwella, Fishermen have no trust on Tuna Forecasting System from NARA. According to a Fisherman at Nilwella, this initiative is not effective due to some practical difficulties regarding locations, depth and other parameters.

records.title: Sayuru
records.description: Sayuru is a coastal early warning system, which has a hotline (828), website and Facebook page. It was started by Dialog in 2019/20 and it provides information on weather forecasts. The target group is one day fishermen in smaller boats. There are TV screens installed in fishing harbours, and a free SMS service for registered users through which the information is disseminated in addition to teh hotline, and FB page. NARA also provides the fishing ground (forecast) information to be shared via the TV screens and Facebook page.

records.title: Tea Leaf Collection Ticket Machine
records.description: The Farmer brings the bag of tea to be weighed to the tea collector/driver, and is then issued a ticket (receipt) for their records. The service provider Smart Metro maintains a database of the farmers, and the farmer name appears on the machine for the receipt when punched in. The farmers can produce the receipt to the factory (at the end of the month) after the tea is sold, to obtain their payment or if the farmer has a bank account the payment is transferred. There is also a mobile app, which has all the same details in the ticket machine database, including farmer bank details and fertiliser use/needs etc. Some tea collectors/factories have a SMS system – where the details of the weight of the tea leaves is sent to the farmer’s phone via SMS.

records.title: AGRO EYE FARMLAND MONITORING SYSTEM
records.description: Elzian-Agro-Eye system is a high-precision outdoor environmental weather and soil monitoring system that is mainly used for industrial and agricultural meteorological environment monitoring. Its support structure is composed of a high-strength pole and three beams through expansion screws, which can effectively resist strong winds. Various weather sensors are installed on the beam, which can accurately measure the current environment’s temperature and humidity, wind speed, wind direction, rainfall, solar radiation, illumination, atmospheric pressure, rainfall, soil moisture/NPK level, soil conductivity.

records.title: Green Plains Grain
records.description: Green Plains Grain mobile application is an easy & simple solution for producers to receive the price for the grain they work hard to grow. records.title: Improving Productivity in Agriculture through Climate-Smart Technology (ImPACT)
records.description: Pessl Instruments GmbH (Pessl), aims to improve the climate resilience of smallholder Filipino farmers through a public-private partnership called “Improving Productivity in Agriculture through Climate-Smart Technology” or ImPACT. Pessl has deployed over 32 proprietary agro-meteorological IoT devices that enable farmers to adopt Climate-Smart Agriculture in their daily farming activities. It's a business to business solution providing services in areas of Farmer Advisory using IoT technologies. It provides advisory covering Rice, Vegetables, Maize, Fruits, Coffee. ImPACT has reduced the input usage of farmers, enabling more precise documentation of farmers’ daily activity and improved crop yields. ImPACT have worked with a control group of 100 farmers, expanding to 5,000 farmers in 2019 and 10,000 farmers by 2020. Deployment will be made sustainable through a service model, e.g. farmers pay $1 per month for the application and are therefore able to save money on chemicals and increase their incomes.

records.title: Farmerlink
records.description: Grameen Foundation developed FarmerLink, which uses digital technology and field agents to provide farmers with complimentary resources. These include agricultural training via tablets or mobile phones, connections to high-value markets, support for organic certification, early warning alerts for extreme weather and pests, training in financial management and access to finance. The same tool is used across each stage by each partner, so people can see what the farmers need, allowing for better assistance. FarmerLink aims to address the development problem of coconut SHFs in the Philippines by: 1) improving productivity, 2) increasing access to financial services, 3) improving direct market linkages, and 4) mitigating the impacts of weather, pest and disease through the use of an early warning system (EWS).

_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital: FarmerLink users gradually learn about and test out and practice all nine GAPs, thereby leading to improved farm income and resilience. At the same time, FarmerLink partnerships help farmers gain access to vital financial and non-financial services, including investment, capacity building and market linkages.

records.title: Cropwise Grower
records.description: The Cropwise Grower application by Syngenta AG is positioned to be farmers' new best friend in the current agriculture environment. The app's Snap, Detect and Diagnose feature lets users take picture of the affected crop and provide real-time identification and solution within the Cropwise Grower app. The app can be used in both online an offline modes. The app guide growers on how to best manage their crops by providing stage-by-stage crop management information on growth, which pests, or disease to look out for at which stage, recommended Syngenta products, best agronomy practice as well as tutorials on how to best use the products. Growers can also see what other growers are saying about the Syngenta recommended solutions as well as tutorials on better crop management. It is the only farming app that will offer services for rice and in future including corn and durian. Using this app, growers connect directly with Syngenta partners, allowing them to find solutions to all their pain points. The app also leverages technology from image recognition specialist Plantix to diagnose crop diseases in three seconds and provide farmers with agronomic advice on the most appropriate type of seed or crop protection that they can apply.

records.title: Smarter Pest and Disease Identification Technology (SPIDTECH)
records.description:
SPIDTECH, an app that collects data from users to analyse and create a map showing the distribution of pests and plant diseases in different parts of the Philippines, includes remote monitoring. This feature is valuable as it facilitates data collection on pests and diseases. The main benefits of this app include 1. Destruction of crops by pests and diseases is one of the main problems faced by cocoa and coffee farmers. It is a challenge to maintain agricultural yields because there are so many factors to consider. Many do not have the opportunity to seek advice from experts who can explain what kind of pests they face and how to deal with them. 2. With this app, researchers at the University of the Philippines Los Baños want to make knowledge about pest control more accessible to farmers with the help of a smartphone application. 3. Currently only available in the Philippines, the developers hope to release a version in the US soon. It works by using the camera on your phone, which matches the images against a database of known pests, and then offers advice on what steps to take. 4. In case no photo is available, it will invite the user to answer some questions to find the matching pest or disease 5. Consumer apps exist that help people manage their houseplants. I’ve used them in the past with mixed success, but the concept is sound. 7. Created by researchers from UP Los Baños, the SPIDTECH smartphone app could be a valuable addition for farmers with limited access to expert advice.
8. If the developers collect information about where pests are appearing, this information could be useful in forming a wide response strategy.

records.title: xarvio® SCOUTING
records.description: The app, which is free to download and use, is available in English, Tagalog, and Cebuano, has been specifically configured to identify local weeds, pests and diseases impacting regional crops such as rice, corn, potato, and tomatoes. xarvio® SCOUTING will enable growers and crop technicians in the Philippines to instantly detect in-field pest and disease threats via photo recognition, and recommend BASF solutions to address identified problems, thus helping to optimize crop production and support sustainability. xarvio® SCOUTING uses an advanced plant modelling platform powered by live algorithms, which can precisely identify unknown weeds, diseases, insects, and calculate leaf damage by simply taking a picture with a smartphone. The app subsequently provides impartial product recommendations to help manage the identified problem. records.title: Farm2Go
records.description: The Farm2Go application is a WFP’s digital agriculture solution for farmer cooperatives to collect digital, real-time data from smallholder farmers and to facilitate the connection between smallholder farmers, aggregators and traders. The app has multiple functionalities including, but not limited to: Digitizing data records, input ordering, access to finance, and SMS communication. To date, the platform has been piloted in four countries – Philippines (in Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM)), Kenya, Mozambique, Rwanda, and Banglades. Farm2Go creates a digital marketplace which connects agriculture cooperatives to the local buyers. WFP is piloting the use of Farm2Go with 15 cooperatives in Maguindanao and Lanao del Sur.

records.title: Accenture Precision Agriculture Service / Connected Crop Solution
records.description: Accenture has combined the technologies such as Internet of Things with its big data analytics, visualization capabilities, and industry knowledge to develop Accenture Precision Agriculture Service to help farmers increase productivity and profitability. By generating detailed insights into operations and the environment, this service assists farmers in making data-based operational decisions to optimize yield and boost revenue while minimizing expenses, the chances of crop failure, and environmental impact. Depending on the crop, the Digital Agriculture Service can help increase overall profitability by $55 to $110 per acre. The Digital Agriculture Service can be used in a wide variety of ways to address inefficiency in farming operations across crop types. For example, the Digital Agriculture Service can help a farmer decide when to harvest. The service could send an alert that a particular plot might be ready for harvest earlier than expected. The farmer can quickly see how each scenario would affect the crop’s profitability. The Accenture Connected Crop Solution connects the three stakeholders—field agent, agro-input company, and farmer—in order to improve agent productivity, product sales, and farmer crop yield. And end-to-end farm management solution, the Accenture Connected Crop Solution integrates and processes data from multiple sources into a single hub via a handheld/smartphone application.

records.title: Rice Doctor
records.description: Developed by Lucid Mobile, the Rice Doctor is an interactive tool for extension workers, students, researchers and other users who want to learn and diagnose pest, disease, and other problems that can occur in rice; and how to manage them. The Australian Centre for International Agricultural Research (ACIAR) has contributed funding for the research, development, and production of this product. It allows users to diagnose or at least make a short list of possible problems occurring in a rice crop. The key covers over 90 pests and diseases and other disorders. The combination of text descriptions and images helps users in the process of diagnosing their problems. Fact sheets on each possible disorder provide brief descriptions of the signs and symptoms of specific problems, together with details of any available management options. A keyword search function enables users to directly access specific fact sheets.

records.title: Binhing Palay (Philippine Rice Variety Catalog)
records.description:
This digital solution provides Philippino farmers with rice variety information including agronomic characteristics, pest and disease resistance, grain quality and other information. The Binhing Palay app offers:
1) Catalog of Philippine rice varieties – The catalog includes all released rice varieties in the Philippines. Sort and filter through the list of rice varieties according to location, environment, season, crop establishment, seed classification, and release year. 2) Rice variety characteristics – Each rice variety comes with full descriptions of their maximum and average yields, maturity, height, number of tillers, recommended domain (season, region, and mode of crop establishment), resistance to pests and diseases, milling potential, physical attributes, and physicochemical characteristics. With these, you can make informed decisions about which rice variety you will use. 3) Rice Seed Key Check – The app also gives instructions from the PalayCheck Keycheck 1 to help you choose and use quality seeds for higher yields. 4) Rice Variety Search – Eager to know more about a particular variety? Binhing Palay’s search function will help you find it faster. 5) Works offline – Binhing Palay app doesn’t need the internet to give you the information you need.

records.title: Automatic Fish Feeder System
records.description: This mobile app based solution electronically switches feed delivery mechanism at timed intervals. The solution help fish farmers in automatically feeding their fish by setting the time and hence reducing the feed and labour expenses as compared to manual feeding. The solution also checks the turbidity level of the water through sensors technology. If the tubidity sensor detect that the water is turbid or not clen the feeder doesn't feed the fish. Key features and benefits include 1) It enables fishermen and businesses to view the histories through android based mobile apps and detect the turbidity levels of a pond 2) Automatic feeder can dispense feed covering a circular motion depending upon the spreading 3) The mass of feeds and turbidity of water can be checked before feeding 4) It also enables fishermen to observe fish growth and health.

records.title: AniTech
records.description: Anihan Technologies, Inc. (AniTech) is B2B Agritech Company that develops and leverages Deep Technologies such as IoT and Analytics to tackle the food loss problem faced by Agri Growers and Suppliers by providing them with actionable data on ambient conditions that affect food quality through our smart sensor system and platform. Through it, they can monitor their operations remotely, avoid mixing spoiled batches with fresh batches, and make real-time supply chain decisions to reduce spoilage. With this complete & flexible solution, AniTech enables  Agri Growers and Suppliers to deliver good-quality fresh goods to their customers. As a result, they can distribute more by spending less resources, helping them become more competitive in the market. The digital solution has 3 components 1) 4-in-1 Sensor System is IoT-based sensor system that monitors the environmental conditions that affect plant growth and crop quality in real time 2) Platform is a Web Based Platform visualizes the data from the Sensor Systems through multiple dashboards 3) Actionable Data is automated reports and email notifications that allows users to determine long-term trends of ambient data and correlate it to the crop’s growth and spoilage.

records.title: AtoANI iCROP
records.description: AtoANI is a social enterprise that distributes fresh produce to its partner B2B customers through its partner farmers using a produce-to-demand agriculture model. It aims to support farming organizations, government institutions, and commercial farmers through its proprietary analytics recommendation platform, AtoANI iCROP. Under the AtoANI iCROP solution, farmers are given recommendations on what to plant using machine learning and data on various crop-growing factors. The solution also promotes transparency built into the platform for revenue and expenses generated from transactions as well as the amount of carbon sequestered for the farmers with the switch to regenerative agriculture. These solutions make AtoANI differ from existing farm-to-market solutions for fresh produce which does not address crop wastage on a preventative and data-based level. AtoANI iCROP solution targets to monetize outside the distribution model with its collaboration with Department of Agriculture SAAD to extend the platform to its beneficiary farmers, which would help the farmers with data-driven crop growing and generate recurring revenue for AtoANI through a subscription and sustainability credits business model.

records.title: Market price information system
records.description: Krishi Bazaar is an agricultural marketplace for farmers and all other stakeholders in Koshi Province of Nepal. Farmers can sell/buy/lease their land, crops, cattle, natural manures, used farm machinery etc on this e-commerce enabled web based solution. The existing value chain that connects farmers to end consumers is intermediated by different layers of agents who procure from small farmer’s wholesales and then sell the product in regional or central agriculture markets. Due to a lack of direct market access, small farmers in far-flung regions are unable to fully capitalize on their final product. There are cases of the monopoly of middle agents due to which farmers get a fraction of the actual market price. To solve this problem the Government of Nepal has launched a digital marketplace called Krishi Bazaar and e-Haat Bazaar to connect farmers directly to the regional and central agricultural marketplace. records.description: Geokrishi (Geo: location specific, Krishi: agriculture) is an integrated agriculture technology (AgTech) developed by Pathway Technologies. Every registered farm is geotagged, enabling location-specific recommendations. The platform offers digital and financial literacy services along with tools and advisory services for about 45 crops and livestock, including tools on cost optimization, weather information, market options, and financial record-keeping along with 30 proven and curated Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) approaches. It applies a data-driven system approach to translate knowledge into actionable, timely and context-specific advisories, covering all stages of the crop value chain.

records.title: AgriClear
records.description: AgriClear help in tracking farmer produce and their agricultural habits using distributed ledger technology (DLT). This allows customers to scan labels with smartphones to access detailed supply chain information, seed plantation, fertilizers used, harvesting process, and origin. Developed by E-Satya, Agri Clear is a blockchain-based traceability solution to share information on food sources and its production process. This information is then logged in a blockchain-based platform to make logs transparent and immutable. In an obscure supply chain with a simple scan of the QR code, a consumer gets to know the provenance of the product and transformation throughout the value chain. Traceability and authenticity using blockchain technology bring in transparency in the food supply chain process and in the long run, can also benefit smallholder farmers by opening up opportunities to access credit and markets.

records.title: Nutrient Expert (NE)
records.description: Nutrient Expert (NE) is an interactive, computer-based decision support system (DSS) which leads individual farmers, or farm advisors, through a step-by-step decision-making process that describes how best to apply nutrients to their rice fields. Prior to its introduction into Nepal, NE Rice has been successfully implemented in India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, as well as in China. The tool has been proven effective in a variety of smallholder cropping systems. Nutrient Expert gives farmer's the confidence that they are using nutrients in the right way. The tool also provides farmers with a clear plan on how to best match the timing of their applications with the periods of peak nutrient demand, which is a critical step to ensuring fertilizers are used most effectively.

records.title: The Venlo greenhouse Solution (Wol Hwa Su Mok Geum Tomatoes)
records.description: Wol Hwa Su Mok Geum Tomatoes is related to plum tomato production based on Venlo greenhouse environmental control system. records.title: Integrated Information System for Fruit Tree Cultivation
records.description: Integrated Information System for Fruit Tree Cultivation solution provides useful and timely information, on weather or insect pest outbreak forecasts for example, to help fruit tree farms prepare against potential risks and minimize losses. It applies smart farming to open fields and orchards, making diverse agricultural environment data available for public use. It provides helpful information to farmers through the Integrated Information System for Fruit Tree Cultivation, in cooperation with data portals of other agencies such as the Rural Development Administration’s Pesticide Safety Information System. The detailed functions include 1) Create a detailed weather map, and provide local weather forecasts 2) Detect, analyze and predict potential weather or climate events affecting fruit trees (via frost/ chilling/ high heat/ high night heat damages, etc.) 3) Predict potential insect pest or disease outbreaks (affecting grapes, pears, apples and peaches) 4) Conduct research on fruit tree growth stages 5) Provide mobile version of Integrated Information System for Fruit Tree Cultivation (allowing farmers to access weather forecasts from their fields) 6) Develop and apply smart farming technologies for grape production and open field orchards

records.title: Seouchae Farm - Smart aquaponics farming
records.description: Seouchae Farm produces high-quality vegetables, leveraging data on crop growth and the environment collected through smart farming systems integrating agriculture with technology. It grows more than 20 types of vegetables and fruits on its farms and supplies its products to leading hotels and restaurants in the country. It is an integrated digital technology with aquaponics farming, a unique form of plant cultivation using natural recirculation. It acquired pesticide-free, Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) and organic certifications, through sustainable and eco-friendly farming practices in which pesticides, chemicals or growth simulators are not used. It also facilitates communication between Greenlabs and member farms, through the interactive knowledge-sharing platform “Farming Knowledge iN” that allows members to ask questions or address issues. It is operating various aquaponics farming education and training programs, ranging from introductory courses to one-month practical experience programs―for extension institutes, universities, returning farmers and businesses. It promotes the benefits of smart farming technology, aquaponics and the rural life, through diverse video contents on the company’s YouTube channel “Aquaponics Farm-Seouchae”.  The solution has following major funnctions 1) Establish greenhouse environment monitoring system, with smart sensors that detect and transmit various data regarding outside temperature/humidity, solar radiation, wind direction/speed, and precipitation and 2) Automatically control various greenhouse equipment and devices (roof/side vents, fans, nutrient controllers, boilers, mist systems, etc.) based on data inputs concerning external conditions

_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
1. Savings of labor resources, increased yields, and maintenance of crop quality

2. Accumulation of big data sets leveraging cloud database

3. Discovered new sales channels through web portals

4. Achieved an upper 80% level customer repurchase rate, and acquired a diverse customer pool that includes five-star hotels.

5. Achieves cost-saving benefits, as aquaponics farming uses 90% less water than conventional openland farming and does not require organic pesticides or chemical fertilizers

6. Can maintain production at a consistent level, since crops get sufficient nutrients for growth from fish

records.title: Younghun Nongsan
records.description:
Distributes crops to wholesalers and retailers at standard prices for agricultural products via an online agricultural product auction platform developed and operated by a public institution in Korea. It expand sales channels and distribute and sell standardized agricultural products at reasonable prices. It is an agricultural products processing center (APC) with facilities necessary for the commercialization of agricultural products, for example for storage, sorting, packaging and logistics, and all stages of agricultural product processing are carried out at the center. In addition, attesting to its excellent quality as a specialized agricultural products wholesale supplier, Younghung Nongsan supplies over 10,000 kilograms of products each day, in large quantities, to major agricultural wholesale markets in Seoul and the surrounding metropolitan area.

The platform for online agricultural product auctions used by Younghung Nongsan is an agricultural product distribution platform, where appropriate prices are determined through online listing of and bidding for agricultural products, and producers and distributors then trade directly. The major players in the online auction are the seller, the Korea Agro-Fisheries & Food Trade Corporation (aT), and the buyer. The main role of the seller is to release products to the online wholesale market, and it bears the responsibility for online listing (information provision), shipping, quality control and delivery. The Korea Agro-Fisheries & Food Trade Corporation (aT) plays the roles of the online wholesale market’s founder and manager, auctioneer, and provider of settlement services and credit. The buyer, meanwhile, purchases the agricultural products listed in the online wholesale market, and is responsible for the price formation and volume distribution.

records.title: Farm Map
records.description: The Farm Map digital solution improves efficiency in agricultural administration and farming, through the building of an aerial image-based digital farmland map. It improves accuracy and efficiency in farmland surveys, the operation of pest control drones, and other activities related to agriculture, by providing the actual locations of and block information on farmlands. The Farm Map is the first digital farmland map that provides farmland locations in the country. As the only map information service in the country, the Farm Map should be acknowledged for its originality. The private sector is also showing much interest in the service, as the number of cases of its utilization with drones is increasing. The Farm Map service uses ortho-images, administrative information and soil maps of the agricultural promotion areas in order to support management of the map-based agricultural promotion areas and reviews of candidate areas for the lifting of agricultural promotion area status based on their soil suitability and land slopes. The Farm Map has enabled the spatial information-based management of agricultural promotion areas, facilitated the establishment of an agricultural promotion area management system utilizing soil suitability grades and land slope, and supported preliminary inspections of candidate areas for the lifting of agricultural promotion area statuses through linkages to information on soil suitability grades5 , slopes of land, and land areas.

_annotations.Name of supplier/developer: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs (MAFRA)
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
1. Through the use of new information generated by the Farm Map and linked with diverse administrative information, the efficiency and accuracy of agricultural administration can be improved.

2. The Farm Map can be used to enhance not only agricultural administration, but also various processes of the agricultural value chain including production, marketing, consumption, and rural development.

records.title: SMARTFARM KOREA
records.description: SmartFarm Korea is building an optimum growing environment for crops through open and integrated data platform for smart farming. It collects, analyze and process smart farm operation datasets, and provide integrated, comprehensive and open access to information on smart farming. SMARTFARM KOREA provides a library of greenhouse horticultural crop and livestock farming datasets through a service called Smartfarm Datamart. Currently this database contains data covering seven greenhouse horticultural crops (tomatoes, cherry tomatoes, strawberries, sweet peppers, cucumbers, eggplants and oriental melons) and livestock production (of beef cattle, dairy cattle, pigs and poultry). The datasets of Smartfarm Datamart comprise field data collected since 2016. SMARTFARM KOREA offers a self-assessment tool for livestock farmers seeking to boost their productivity and sales through advanced technologies and data-driven farm operations. Farmers can gauge their farms’ digital readiness for the use of a big data analytics platform by entering details about their farms concerning for example the livestock species they raise, their breeding environments, the diseases/insects they are exposed to, and their farm operations.

records.title: Jeonnam Sinan-gun Office
records.description: Jeonnam Sinan-gun Office provides management of tidal flats octopus production using artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things. records.title: FarmOS
records.description: FarmOS is a company that develops environmental controllers for farms. It created a program that precisely controls irrigation according to the grape model. It has built new services such as linking weather information, supporting high-quality grape production, and precision irrigation services to save time and cost. Unlike existing sensor-based control methods, control tailored to high-quality grape production was realized. Instead of providing existing cloud-based digital solutions, the system was configured based on local machine control that allows automatic on-site control even when communication is lost. records.title: Farmdar
records.description: Farmdar is a startup launched in 2021 which has raised USD 1.3 million in 2022. Farmdar uses deep-tech with high- res, multi-band satellite imagery to create actionable data for farmers and corporates. This data has a direct result on the efficiency and profitability of farmers and corporates. Farmdar offers precision agriculture tools related to insights on crop classification, harvest monitoring, yield estimation, sowing classification, field digitization, climate monitoring, variety detection, NPK (Nitrogen, Phosphorous, Potassium) variable application reporting, water stress reporting, plant health, and stress reporting across 3 services called Crop Scan, AgromAI and IQ Dashboard. Another feature called Variety Scan allows Farmdar to detect which variety of sugarcane is grown. records.title: IntelliCrop
records.description: Active since 2019 in Pakistan, IntelliCrop is an invaluable tool for identifying plant diseases and diagnosing potential issues on crops. It's an AI-based mobile app designed to detect the health of crop leaves and identify any possible diseases or deficiencies in nutrients. The app uses deep learning and artificial intelligence – meaning it actually learns from each image you feed it – and is currently undergoing trails using different crops, with the aim of perfecting its results. It can be used by both farmers and crop advisors alike to quickly identify problems in plants, assess disease severity, and share their findings with other members of their technical team. With detailed recommendations for further action that can help increase yield and improve overall crop health, this app provides a practical solution to assist growers with plant disease identification and treatment decisions.

records.title: FarmGhar
records.description: Providing services through web based system and mobile apps, FarmGhar is Pakistan's one of the largest online livestock, dairy and Qurbani animals marketplace. FarmGhar offers delivery service with farmGhar guarantee. The delivery services include Home Collection & Delivery, and Cash on Delivery. It's a simple to use mobile application and It can be used for every day trade of the livestock animals for meat and dairy as well as for sale and purchase of Qurbani animals for Eid-Ul-Adha with home delivery anywhere in Pakistan.

Value added services like ‘Payment Guarantee’, ‘Verified animals’ and ‘Self-Stock’ have helped to add confidence in secure online buying and selling. This has also encouraged women farmers to sell or buy animals through farmGhar platform without facing any difficulties of the physical markets.

records.title: Food Traceability Solution
records.description: The Food Traceability Solution is an end-to-end application for farm traceability across the agricultural supply chain. This solution allows users to take command of their farming operations by providing accurate and real-time information at essential control points. Quality control and agricultural output can be exponentially augmented with accurate data and timely imposition of best farming practices using this application. Moreover, compliance with the latest farming regulations is simplified with accurate accountability and traceability across the farm. Food Traceability Solution provides consumers with a sense of relief about their food safety by making each farming process transparent. Any form of food adulteration, pesticide residue, or additive is effectively tracked to ensure that natural farming practices are implemented at every level. Active since 2020 and providing services mainly though mobile apps but they do have some web based features as well for reporting etc. They have clients in Pakistan and 4 other countries.

records.title: SoilSense
records.description: SoilSense is a unique solution to assessing soil health and increasing agricultural output. The solution offers a 20-minute test that can test the soil for microbial biomass which is a critical soil health indicator. This IoT-enabled solution was developed by Crewlogix Technologies with the vision of bringing a data-driven approach to agriculture. With SoilSense, results are provided in real-time without being have to sent to soil testing labs. Key metrics such as the efficacy of soil amendments or carbon content in the soil can enable smarter farming decisions, and support regenerative agriculture. Geo-location and soil tests are stored on your device and can be effortlessly accessed, integrated, or shared across your project management teams using the mobile application or web portal. Active since 2020 and providing services mainly though mobile apps but they do have some web based features as well for reporting etc. They claim to have clients in Pakistan and 4 other countries.

records.title: Irrigation Advisory SMS Service for Farmers
records.description: PCRWR launched the service on April 18, 2016 which is an outcome of international collaboration extended by the University of Washington (UW) and NASA. The UW is providing real time daily Potential Evapotranspiration (ET) and precipitation for entire Pakistan using NASA’s remotely sensed data. PCRWR determined crop coefficients (Kc) for different crops in different agro-climatic zones of Pakistan. The service informs the farmers about their net weekly irrigation requirements, considering ET and precipitation. In the long run, PCRWR envisions extending the service to all farmers of irrigated areas, through international and national coordination. Active since 2016 in over 40 districts of Pakistan. Mainly SMS service based advisory in local languages.

_annotations.Name of supplier/developer: Pakistan Council of Research in Water Resources (PCRWR)
_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di: 20,000 farmers across major crop value chains such as wheat, maize, sugarcane, cotton and rice
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
10% - 15% increase in yield due to the right irrigation practices
A reduction in the cost of irrigation related expenses
_annotations.Digital Solution Geographic scope (Enter: More than 40 districts all over Pakistan

records.description: Pessl Instument's weather stations are deployed in many projects and farms (strategically placed on fields) in Pakistan targeting farmer. records.title: Nishat Dairy Farm Management Solution
records.description: Active since 2018, a complete cattle farm management solution was developed which translates all cow data into practical information that is used to make decisions. It includes herd status, health management and insemination & fertility modules. Mobile apps were designed and developed to keep stakeholders informed and in control of tasks such as insemination, sorting, treatments (vaccinations, diagnostics etc.), calving, pregnancy check and abortion. The tool was further enhanced with cow sensors and hardware integrations. Automated feeding programs optimized the feed each animal receives according to her stage in lactation, pregnancy, yield and body condition. The integrated solution provides seamless data transfer from the sensors to a central server which allows for accurate monitoring of the herd structure, fertility, health and milk production — all remotely without any need for physical travel. This complete system helps to make decisions faster, ensuring more cost-efficient and effective herd management operations.

The integrated solution provides seamless data transfer from the sensors to a central server which allows for accurate monitoring of the herd structure, fertility, health and milk production — all remotely without any need for physical travel. This complete system helps to make decisions faster, ensuring more cost-efficient and effective herd management operations.

records.title: UpTrade (Goats for Water)
records.description: UpTrade is a vertically integrated livestock value chain company. They work directly with small and mid-sized livestock farmers, leveraging data to improve the quality of livestock and create direct access to markets and tailored bartering programs. The have the ultimate mission to bring together both ends of the livestock chain: smallholder farming families that are raising animals and meat consumers. This ultimately results in improving the economic prosperity and quality of life for smallholder farmers and their communities. With their Goats for Water program innovative bartering program, they enable smallholder rural, off-grid farming communities to meet their farming and household needs using livestock as currency.  Their technical team and product partners design, install and maintain solar based pumping solutions  based on the specific water requirements of each community, hydraulic profile and the capacity to pay. Their products and services also include E-Mandi, which is UpTrade's electronic livestock market platform which provides an innovative solution to small-holder livestock farmers and low income households looking for direct access to markets and alternative financing mechanisms. The company also has a Goats for Solar program, which enables them to trade their livestock for access to solar energy products and solar micro-grids.

records.title: Radical Growth Solutions
records.description: They make hardware and software that enable farmers to make data driven decisions by delivering actionable messaging directly to the farmer’s phone to optimize irrigation and fertigation, eliminating the guesswork from agriculture and enhancing overall savings and yield. They have a broad array of sensors, real time in-field monitoring, water and fertilizer usage traceability and a user friendly web platform. Their agri-kit allows them to have more hardware per acre which allows for more data points and higher accuracy in each decision made. Their soil sensors collect data on NPK, moisture, temperature and electrical conductivity at multiple depths. They also use ag-specific weather services to provide precise weather information relevant for farmers. They are also using various crop models to predict behavior of crops from aspects such as water uptake, nutrient uptake, water and salinity stresses. They have offices in USA, Bahrain and Pakistan.

_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
80% water saving
15% enhanced yield
70% over-all savings

records.title: Trash It
records.description: TrashIt encourages people to reconsider lifestyle habits influenced by production and consumption trends, and to shift towards sustainable living. records.title: Celefish Digital Fishery Platform
records.description: Celefish is a digital fishery platform from China, that offers fish farming technology services for farmers. The company’s solution is a digital service for a smart recirculating aquaculture system and a digital service for the supply chain that improves quality and standardization of the product, targeted at business customers. Through their solution, they can provide digital services for fisherfolk, enhance farmer capability and skills while reducing cost. The Digital Service for Fishing Villages with Outdoor Fish Ponds (DFV) service from Celefish is focused on establishing and constructing a fishery IoT infrastructure to establish an aquaculture, quality control and sales service platform. The system has water quality and health monitoring services, aquaculture input and data value-added services and quality control and traceability as well as sales related services. The service collects data through IoT devices, stores it on cloud-based platforms for big data and catalyzes digital ecosystem collaboration.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di: At present, more than 50,000 users have been registered on the platform and the IoT is used for monitoring by more than 7,000 fishpond users.
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital: The business model is both B2C and B2B, with DFV fisherfolk paying a data service and value-added service fee in exchange for AI and data services, aquaculture devices, selling services and quality control whereas business customers gain access to high quality, safe fish, and supply chain services for procurement of aquatic production. Celefish’s beneficiaries are the fisherfolk that gain access to data informed insights, aquaculture devices as well as access to market.

records.title: Gokomodo
records.description: Gokomodo is a leading Indonesian agritech supply chain company. Gokomodo is a B2B company for agribusiness supply chain and services in Indonesia that aims to provide easy access to high-quality products at competitive prices through procurement, e-commerce, and distribution platforms. Gokmodo aims to create easy and equal access to good quality, competitively priced agri-inputs for stakeholders in the Indonesian agribusiness sector, from smallholders to corporates, through its integrated physical and digital infrastructure. Gokomodo is currently present in 7 provinces. The company works with leading agribusinesses, Village Cooperatives (KUD) and retail farming shops (Toko Tani) to distribute agri-inputs and ultimately empower smallholders, towards supporting national agriculture productivity.

records.title: Langit Collective
records.description: Langit Collective is an accredited social enterprise in Malaysia that was formed in 2015. They started with the promotion of unique and heirloom agricultural produce by smallholder farmers from East Malaysia to larger markets. Through this, farmers enjoy a fair price with each procurement, whilst increased economic opportunities encourage them to preserve their culture, sustainable farming practices, and heritage seeds. Langit also design and implement customised learning experiences for entrepreneurial communities or organisations who work on livelihood programs. This contributes to empowering of communities through new skills and knowledge. Langit works across 3 different rural farming communities in Sabah and Sarawak. Each community produce unique crop that thrives on their land. These communities include Heirloom Rice & Grains Farmers; Layo Farmers (naturally farmed ginger); Lada Bihis (farmer's niche, lada kuching variety).

records.title: Qarbotech Sdn. Bhd.
records.description: Qarbotech is a leading sustainability and green tech company that is committed to using technology to make a positive impact on the world. The company’s flagship product, QarboGrow, is a revolutionary photosynthesis enhancement technology that helps farmers increase crop yields while reducing their environmental impact. Drought resistance has been demonstrated in QarboGrow-treated crops. In countries where there is less sunlight, it might help the agricultural sector. QarboGrow can also improve fertilizer efficiency. This will help to avoid excessive chemical release into the environment.

_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital: As of September 2023, we have produced and sold about 8000 liters of photosynthesis enhancer to home gardeners and agropreneurs, helping their plants remove an additional 3 tonnes of CO2 from the atmosphere. We have also impacted the lives of 50 smallholder farmers. We hope to reach 800 more smallholder agropreneurs in Malaysia and Indonesia for the next six months to increase agricultural productivity and crop yield.

records.title: FARMIS
records.description: FARMIS mobile app is developed and managed by the Fresh Produce Development Agency PNG, to supply information on market prices and weather and crop advisory services that can be tailored to farmer needs, such as pest and disease management information, or crop and agromet advisory. Additionally, FARMIS informs farmers on the availability of inputs for major crops in real time and offers a tool for farmers to enter all their crop expenses and keep track of daily expenses. All content is provided by FPDA. Besides relevant content, the app is designed to include a number of useful features and functionalities, such as a messaging platform for direct interaction with technical experts on crop agronomy and management; farm calculators to help farmers understand how to maximise the financial efficiency of their operation; news and event reports; and interactive voice and text recognition through natural language processing for disabled and visually impaired farmers and users (ChatBot).

records.title: Farmforce enterprise
records.description: The mobile interface of Farmforce’s digital tool used by PNG Agriculture Company's (PNGAC) field officers is a purpose-built Android OS app. Field officers equipped with smartphones use Farmforce for digital collection of farm and farmer data, such as farm size and geolocation, soil quality and crop growing activities at different phases of the production process, from planting to harvesting. Application focuses on producers and exporters of cocoa, coffee, soya, palm oil, cattle, wood, and rubber. Data s collected at various intervals every time a field officer interacts with the farmer. The app allows for online and offline data collection, permitting field officers to gather data in areas with poor mobile network coverage. The data is then synced to the office server once the user is within coverage. The PNGAC’s operating model also includes Bluetoothenabled digital scales that field officers use at cocoa procurement points. The scales feed procurement weights to the Farmforce app while a Bluetooth printer is used to issue paper receipts to farmers. Barcode scanning is also available in the mobile app for postharvest traceability

records.title: Olam Farmer Information System (OFIS)
records.description: The OFIS app (by Olam) is a farm management and farm advisory tool used for crops such as cocoa, coffee, cashew and cotton. For the cocoa value chain, understanding the location, type and quality of the cocoa fermentary is central to assessing and managing the quality of the fermented beans. The information is collected by field extension officers at onboarding phase and updated during regular visits through OFIS-equipped Android smartphones. Due to network coverage limitations and data service costs, the information is typically collected offline and synced once data connectivity is restored. Using OFIS, the technology developer is able to collect and analyse detailed farm and farmer data, including farmer demographics, farm location and size, number of trees and more. Across Papua New Guinea, over 4,200 cocoa farmers are now profiled on the OFIS app.

records.title: PNG Pig
records.description: PNG Pig is a blockchain technology based traceability solution for livestock, watermelon, capsicum and coffee. Given the importance of pigs as income generating asset and with social impacts in the highlands of the Jiwaka region, a pilot project was initiated to develop the distributed ledger technology (blockchain) application for pig value chains. A livestock traceability system using blockchain technology was developed and piloted in the North Whagi and South Whagi districts to establish “proof of concept.” Pig farmers registered for the project and provided up to five pigs for being ear-tagged. The RFID-enabled tags were linked to the database of the traceability system. A mobile application, PNG Pigs, was developed for the traceability system and used for the registration of pigs and the continued uploading of performance data. Since the launch of the pilot on 11 March 2019, 15 farmers and 50 pigs were registered. Farmers participated byinputting data into the system throughout the life of the project until animals were ready for sale. The system tracked and recorded the history of the pigs. When pigs were ready for sale, potential buyers were expected to visit pig selling points and utilize the app to scan the ear-tags and view the animal’s history before making their purchase.

_annotations.Name of supplier/developer: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

records.title: Mobile Market Information Service (MMIS)
records.description: The Mobile Market Information Service (MMIS) project was initiated by the Fresh Produce Development Agency (FPDA) to provide up-to-date market information of fresh produce to smallholder farmers and other players in the value chain. Smallholder farmers have the opportunity to get up-to-date market information on their produce through their mobile phones. This service provides information on prices, supplies and quality of various fruits and vegetables available at any given time at selected urban markets around the country. To access market information, users are required to send a short message service (SMS) using a specified call code to Digicel, the service provider, with an appropriate product code. After sending the SMS, users will receive a return message containing the desired information at any urban market instantly.

records.title: GREENCoffee solution
records.description: Launched in 2016, the GREENCoffee solution provides the farmers with timely and accurate market information, tailored crop calendars, and good agricultural practice information via SMS and in dedicated mobile apps based on satellite and other geo-information sources. The system is financially sustained using subscription fees for farmers and B2B (business to business) service models to other actors in the coffee value chain e.g. roosters, traders etc. The GREENCoffee solution supports 100.000 coffee farmers in the region of the Central Highlands in Viet Nam (Dak Lak, Gia Lai, Kon Tum and Lam Dong provinces) with targeted information on weather conditions, best practices and market information. The project is funded by the G4AW (Geodata for agriculture and water) facility of the Dutch Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands.

records.title: JALA shrimp farm management solution
records.description: Jala, is an Indonesian based agritech that specializes in shrimp farming and prevent harvest losses and production uncertainty by providing digital services consisting of the application of the internet of thing (IoT) supported by sensors submerged into shrimp pond to measyre and gather the water quality data and send it to the cloud. Jala Tech has developed a precision data-powered shrimp farm management platform and app that supports the shrimp industry. Farmers enter data directly into the Jala App and receive AI-enabled analytics to help forecast shrimp harvests. Also, the mobile platform helps the farmers control the water quality data and its analysis of their shrimp farm along with financial management. In Viet Nam, Jala Tech solution is contrinuting to the revitalization of Viet Nam’s shrimp production. Since 2021 the technology was accepted by GRAFT Challenge programme which aims to solve the most pressing challenges facing Viet Nam’s aquaculture and fisheries industry.

records.title: i-feeder (AI based smart solution)
records.description: The AquaEasy startup partnered with Grobest Group (October 2022) to provide ICT and digital based solutions to improve whiteleg shrimp farming. Under the partnership agreement, Grobest Group introduces AquaEasy’s smart innovations to their customers, including AI-driven solutions, intelligent feeders (i-feeder) and ShrimpTalk. i-feeder is a smart solution that offer users feeding suggestions based on AI decision-making algorithms, with the use of data analysis from smart sensors and software that is stored on a cloud By being able to measure and monitor shrimp farm environment in real-time, it is specifically designed to "listen" to the shrimp's behaviour, observe their hunger level, schedule appropriate feeding time, and provide optimised amount of food. As a result, over-feeding is avoided, enabling high productivity and improving farmers livelihoods.

records.title: FarmAI
records.description: FarmAI is a mobile application which digitizes and measures fields, reduces paper work through digital activity logging, and provides users with relevant weather information and advice, at the field level. FarmAI also promotes collaboration among members of farming communities. Farmers can invite their fellow farmers to work in their farm, or join a cooperative or an organization to get timely and relevant farming advice. FarmAI's benefits to farmers include increase income and farm management; enhanced productivity through activity logging; monitor and identify problems in the field through precision farming technologies; access to market opportunities; access to modern, and sustainable farming techniques through knowledge and support features. FarmAI is being utilized by over 20,000 smallholder farmers in Japan, Thailand, and Viet Nam (helping them improve their farm management efficiency by 25%).

records.title: System for Saving Water (SWFF)
records.description: MimosaTEK is an internet-integrated system that helps farmers produce more food with less water. This is an example of an internet-connected system for precision irrigation that smallholder farmers can easily use to manage irrigation levels, saving both crops and water. The MimosaTEK system works by placing sensors in farmers’ greenhouses or fields, which measure environmental factors such as soil moisture, precipitation, air temperature, and wind speed. The sensors measure factors in real time and then recommends an irrigation schedule for the farmers. Farmers can read these recommendations through an app in their smartphones and plan their water use accordingly. MimosaTEK’s system offers quick, accurate information about the weather and soil conditions, along with tailored recommendations on the best irrigation schedules. As of July 2019, MimosaTEK has installed about 100 systems in Viet Nam.

records.title: Agrio
records.description: Agrio app is an artificial intelligence-based solution that enables farmers to identify and treat plant diseases and pests. It uses a deep learning-based computer vision algorithm that surpasses human capability and integrates the knowledge of numerous experts. The app's basic system feature is free and identifies crop diseases, pests, nutritional deficiencies, and abiotic stresses and provides treatment suggestions across multiple methods (i.e., biological, cultural, organic, and chemical). Users can opt to submit their images to a forum where they communicate directly with in-house agricultural experts for additional guidance. Agrio provides farmers with quality precision agriculture and supplements the lack of agriculture extension experts worldwide. Within Agrio, users can subscribe to AgrioShield, which is the first artificially intelligent global alert system that generates warning alerts to farmers and inspectors based on geographical spread and forecasting models. AgrioShield is offered on a sliding scale depending on the income of the nation.

records.title: CheckIT
records.description: Yara CheckIT is an agricultural mobile device app that gives farmers a photographic library of crops to allow a simple and fast identification of possible nutrient deficiencies. With CheckIT farmers can search through photos of nutrient deficiencies, filter them by symptoms, the location of the symptom on the crop, or by the suspected cause of the symptom and then use this to identify the probable deficiency. Once farmers have decided on the cause of the deficiency CheckIT gives the further information on how the deficiency affects that crop, what soil types are prone to this type of deficiency and what factors will make a deficiency worse. CheckIT also gives farmers a fertilizer recommendation to treat the identified deficiency, as well as alternative products which allow preventive treatment for the following growing season. CheckIT also works well in rural locations with low signal strength although if there is no signal product recommendations will be limited. CheckIT lets farmers make an on-the-spot identification of a crop deficiency, and at the same time give advice and recommendations to correct the deficiency and so improve crop quality and increase yield.

records.title: eFishery
records.description: eFishery is an aquaculture technology startup which offers digitally-controlled automatic feeder for smallholder fisher and shrimp farmers. It also creates linkage between farmers and feed suppliers and other inputs using an on-line market platform. eFishery relies on IoT devices, data analytics and connectivity and allows farmers to control fish feeding on their ponds directly from their mobile devices. eFishery services expanded to finance support and e-commerce services for participating farmers. Launched in 2013. The four main products of eFishery are an automatic feeding device for fish and shrimp (eFisheryFeeder), a fish feed product (eFisheryFeed), a financial scheme for farmers (eFisheryFund) and an online platform connecting fish farmers with customers (eFisheryFresh). Through eFisheryKu mobile application, all aquaculture transactions and commerce can be done online easily and reliably. FisheryKu is an application created to help you run your aquaculture business. This application opens access to a variety of services from eFishery, from feed to funding. Through eFisheryKu mobile application, all aquaculture transactions and commerce can be done online easily and reliably.

_annotations.Digital Solution Geographic scope (Enter: Several fish villages in Indonesia and expanding to other Asian countries (need to verify exact villages and possible reach in other regions of Indonesia)

records.title: SIPINDO
records.description: Sipindo (Indonesian Agricultural Information System) is an android-based agricultural application that provides the farmers throughout Indonesia with easy access to agricultural information such as plant cultivation techniques, plant disease pests, and providing market access for their buying and selling needs. Specifically, it provides real-time and tailor-made advice to cucumber, tomato and chili farmers in Java and Lampung. This way farmers receive specific advice about the actual weather conditions and the available nutrients in the soil according to their location. records.title: Kisaan Suvidha
records.description: Kisaan Suvidha is a marketing platform that brings together the Agricultural Produce Marketing committee (APMC), farmers and agents under one marketing platform operating as a mobile application. Farmers can see the live auction of any commodity and follow price variations (maximum, minimum and average price) of any commodity on a daily basis throughout the year. Farmers can only be present at ARPMC during the aution time and when weight measurement is required. Through the SMS facility provided to the app users, farmers receive auction price and total amount to collect from the agents. The agent can track the activity like commodities sold and bought by him/her. The agents also track the details of Gate Pass, auctions, and fees collection. The APMC agent can extract information about goods damages and calcualtes the total village level commodity and revenue generates. On the same app, the commodity merchants can analyse the ups and downs of all the APMC in the state, and get information of total fees paid by him. The Government bodies can view the total stock of any commodity at an APMC and review village, sub-district, district wise production.

_annotations.Digital Solution Type (Category & sub-ca: Digital Agrifood Services :: Market and price data analytics

records.title: Meghdoot

records.description: StarAgri is one of Asia’s leading integrated post-harvest management services companies. The solutions target challenges like post-harvest loss, access to bank finances and poor links to markets. records.title: Arya Digital
records.description: Arya is India’s leading Agritech which has been working at the farmgate to strengthen agriculture value chains through its integrated range of services.  Through its profitable business model with over 5.0 million tonnes of storage capacity across 5,500 warehouses in 21 Indian states, Arya helps farmers, aggregators, farmer producer organisations, food processors and end-user corporates avoid post-harvest losses. Powered through its platform, Arya.ag, it efficiently connects the supply side of the Agri ecosystem with the demand side through a comprehensive portfolio of agri-services. Arya assists sellers of agri-commodities to avoid distress sale of produce by extending post-harvest credit. It’s integrated and easy-to-use platform also helps users to choose ancillary services like warehouse management, access to finance, quality testing, storage protection services, and connects produce to buyer through a robust technology-enabled back-end ecosystem.

records.title: Intelligent Agricultural Systems Advisory Tool
records.description: The Intelligent Agricultural Systems Advisory Tool (ISAT), developed by a collaboration of Microsoft, Indian Meteorological Department (IMD), Acharya NG Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU), and ICRISAT, provides concise farm advisories to farmers on their phones. ISAT provides concise farm advisories to farmers via messages that are generated after analysis of local and global historical climate data, current and forecasted weather conditions, crop systems and soil-related information. The tool employs a decision-tree approach to generate SMSes, which are then relayed to farmers registered for the service.

records.title: Agribuddy
records.description: Agribuddy is a digital platform that is both web and application enabled that connects farmers to resources and networks. Through the platform, farmers use a “buddy” to store data and order supplies as needed. Agribuddy enables farmers to have access to capital through bank loans, as well as higher quality farm inputs. The goal is to connect the input suppliers to the digital platform using a cashless transaction system. The digital platform understands what farmers need (seeds, pesticides, tractors, etc.) and when they need it, so farmers can focus on farming. This reduces the stress and hassle for the farmers and significantly improves the output in terms of harvest. Agribuddy’s large farmer network boosts their revenues, and in the future all aspects of the transactions will be on the blockchain which improves traceability. The main platform capabilities include: (i) facilitating access and provision of critical inputs by participating farmers in a timely manner as required by the value chain; (2) Buddies are the main sources of data input into the system, and are mentors to farmers who are learning to use the digital platform; (3) Each Buddy can manage up to 50 farmers get a commission from the farming lifecycle.

_annotations.Digital Solution Type (Category & sub-ca: Digital Agrifood Services :: Supply chain management
_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di: 24,846 Farmers registered

records.title: iFarmer digital
records.description: iFarmer platform improves Bangladeshi farmers access to capital, advisory services, and markets, amid a booming middle class. From the app or website, farm investors sponsor a head of livestock, or crop, selecting their farm of choice with a fixed rate of return to be paid to them at the end of the stipulated farm cycle (4-12 months) along with the initial capital. The website provides farm updates for investors. Investors are individuals - many are in Dhaka, some are outside of Bangladesh. Most smallholder farmers prefer to share profits instead of pay interest, but larger operations prefer interest. Input retail agents facilitate farmers' participation, and and show them agronomic learning modules on the app. Farmers can also call in iFarmer to ask agronomic questions. iFarmer takes the role of an aggregator for sales, facilitating or directly transacting with large food retailers, to ensure good prices. Currently, value chains include a selection of plant crops and livestock; plan to expand to fish and poultry. iFarmer is also developing a lending tool for financial institutions to be integrated.

records.description: Agvisely helps extension agents and farmers in Bangladesh and South Asia to increase agricultural resilience to climate risks. The system integrates location-specific meteorological forecasts generated by the Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD) with thresholds for crucial whether variables. When a threshold is forecasted to be passed, an automatic system provides location-specific management advice for farmers. Advisories are based on the Bangladesh Agricultural Research Council’s recommendations and are verified by the Department of Agricultural Extension. records.title: Fall Armyworm Monitor
records.description: The Fall Armyworm Monitor was developed by the International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center (CIMMYT) in cooperation with Bangladesh’s Department of Agricultural Extension, through the Fighting Back Against Fall Armyworm project, supported by USAID and Michigan State University. The Fall Armyworm Monitor collects population, incidence and severity data, and guides pest management decisions. The web tool relies on information gathered by farmers using smartphones in their fields. It assists agricultural development planners, extension agents, and farmers to make informed integrated pest management decisions to mitigate the threat posed by Fall Armyworm. The Fall Armyworm Monitor has become an essential tool for government officials to aid farmers in managing the pest which so far has been successful. This web portal is a very efficient way to collect data from the field. Anyone can access the page to see the overall condition of infestation across the country. Farmers can check the portal every week to find out about the fall armyworm condition, infestation level with the overall field conditions.
