_raw.Brief Description: The Fall Armyworm Monitor was developed by the International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center (CIMMYT) in cooperation with Bangladesh’s Department of Agricultural Extension, through the Fighting Back Against Fall Armyworm project, supported by USAID and Michigan State University. The Fall Armyworm Monitor collects population, incidence and severity data, and guides pest management decisions. The web tool relies on information gathered by farmers using smartphones in their fields. It assists agricultural development planners, extension agents, and farmers to make informed integrated pest management decisions to mitigate the threat posed by Fall Armyworm. The Fall Armyworm Monitor has become an essential tool for government officials to aid farmers in managing the pest which so far has been successful. This web portal is a very efficient way to collect data from the field. Anyone can access the page to see the overall condition of infestation across the country. Farmers can check the portal every week to find out about the fall armyworm condition, infestation level with the overall field conditions.

records.title: FishBangla
records.description: Fish Bangla is a unique mobile app designed to purchase and sale fish online. People, including farmers, can buy and sell fish from this app in to retail and wholesale markets. Fishes are freshly caught and shipped directly from a handpicked farmers and shipped drirectly to the markets. The app provides information to fish suppliers (e.g., smallholder fish farmers, fisherman) about best practices in fish cultivation and prohibits them from using fromaldahyde or other contaminants on the fish. Some of the exclusive features of this app include buyer and sellers can keep their own profiles with detailed information; product list (to buy and sell); sellers list; history of buying and sellings; and contact details.

records.title: Geopotato
records.description: GEOPOTATO is a geodata-driven decision support system that provides early alert to registered potato farmers for spraying preventive fungicide via SMS and voice message three days prior to a possible late blight attack. GEOPOTATO DSS combines satellite image processing data of potato crop biomass growth and real-time weather data from Automatic Weather Stations (AWS) to determine conducive environment for late blight attack. Alerts are delivered to farmers via SMS and voice message. Ensuring optimal fungicide spraying has economic and environmental benefits. The info is provided to farmers through web based and mobile application componenets of this service.

records.title: Plantix
records.description: Plantix app allows users to upload a photo showing a problem with their crop; the system - using a combination of intelligent automation and review by experts - sends back a diagnosis and prescribed action to take. It helps overcome information gaps and disparities for farmers by identifying issues associated with crop production and solutions, also giving farming tips and weather information. The pilot was conducted with 260 farmers and industry actors in seven districts of Bangladesh. Results showed that women who used Plantix were able to make better-informed decisions about their crops, which led to the women having more status and voice within their families and communities. A retailer e-commerce platform is now being rolled out in India and Bangladesh

records.title: Rupali
records.description: Rupali is an Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IoT) based mobile application for fish farming. Its purpose is to enhance the capacity of smallholder farmer and the extension agents through customized advisory services, information and insight on advanced aquaculture practice. Images of ponds have been analyzed, with app makes data available through on chemical oxygen demand, biochemical oxygen demand, dissolved oxygen and dissolved carbon, hygiene situation, and fish growth. The intention is to use artiificial intelligence to make recommendations that are sent out to farmers by SMS and/or calls. Rupali aims to be a catalyst in terms of providing access to quality inputs, product knowledge through the local input providers in order to increase productivity of small holder fish farmers.

records.title: SHUFOLA digital
records.description: SHUFOLA is a highly localized agriculture advisory service that combines crop management practices with weather conditions. Based on their crop, variety, growth stage, and weather condition, farmers receive customized and actionable advisory via SMS and Voice Message in local dialect to basic phones. For observed weather data, Automatic Weather Stations are used and for forecast data, Weather Research and Forecasting Model output is used. The tool automatically cross references weather data with expert validated agro advisories considering different stages of farming. This data then interacts with farmer profile information and predefined agricultural contents in a Decision Support System, which then generates farmer-specific agro recommendation, which is dispatched to farmers through SMS and voice message.

records.title: Sudhokko
records.description: The Sudhokko smartphone app is primarily intended for use among livestock service providers (LSPs), with the support of livestock officers, while making farmers more confident in the services being provided. The app includes schedule creating; details regarding providing medical care; medicine selection based on disease/symptoms; accounts keeping; calculating transportation cost and call records  reminders. It also contains videos that LSPs can share with farmers. After a visit from a participating livestock service provider, farmers receive a text message with a visit summary, details on treatments and prescriptions, and have the chance to provide feedback on services. The app has been tested with 100-120 LSPs since October 2019. Companies can promote their products on the app. The data generated by the LSPs in using the app is curated into a web-based Market Intelligence Platform with livestock pharma companies and research organizations as the end users. The platform will avail them information like disease pattern, medicine usage pattern of LSPs in different types of diseases, usage of their own brands of products as well as other brands by LSPs etc. An added Breed Identification and Cattle Registry feature helps the artificial insemination (AI) technician to identify the breed of a particular cow, by matching the types and percentages of exotic breed charecteristic present in that cow, in order to make optimum recommendation for AI selection.

_annotations.Digital Solution Type (Category & sub-ca: Digital Agriculture :: Livestock management & animal health

records.title: Adarsha Pranisheba
records.description: PraniSheba is a Bangladeshi AgriTech and InsurTech startup that assists marginal cattle farmers in Bangladesh with IoT-based cattle identification, wellbeing monitoring, insurance, access to finance, crowdfunding, online veterinary services and forward market linkage support. It is a provider of IoT-based cattle farm management and monitoring software. It offers a digital platform using IoT (Internet of Things), RFID, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning technologies to determine and record cow species, genetic development, information conservation, reproduction, dairy management, and provision of primary treatment. It also offers cattle insurance services. Their different offered solutions include: PROHORI: an IoT-based Remote Cowshed Monitoring System that provides 24/7 surveillance of cowsheds and sends out call-to-action messages whenever it detects high-risk conditions. FINACCESS: Through Easy Pack, one of our introductory technology platforms that employ AI and ML to identify individual cattle populations, provides cattle muzzle recognition access to insurance, low-cost lending, and well-being monitoring services. VET: an online telemedicine platform that provides 24/7 veterinary services. SHOP: eCommerce platform that ensures forward market linkage to rural cattle farmers. SHARED FARMING: crowdfunding platform that matches up urban investors with marginal farmers.The mobile application is available on Android platforms.

records.title: Khaasfood
records.description: Khaas Food, founded in 2015, provides the population of over 160 million in Bangladesh with access to safe, unadulterated, and wholesome food, thereby contributing to a healthier and happier life for current and future generations. It began as an e-commerce platform (web portal and mobile app) and since then has expanded to include a chain of 16 brick-and- mortar stores. They  offer an extensive range of over 200 products, including dairy, honey, spices, oils, and more, catering to the diverse needs of their customers. At the heart of its business model is the direct procurement from a network of over 1 thousand farmers and 100+ SMEs bypassing traditional middleman. It helps to reduce cost associated with intermediaries and  farmers to get fair price for their produce. They maintain close relationship with farmers, support by providing advise, modern farming technique and financial assistance and thereby ensuring quality and consistent supply. records.title: Deshifarmer
records.description: DeshiFarmer is a Bangladeshi multi-agricultural stakeholder platform that provides services to farmers including agri-inputs, crop advisory, sorting, grading and packaging. With DeshiFarmer’s current solution, farmers can purchase agri-inputs and machinery, receive direct financial support from formal institutions and can apply for insurance for their crops. They have also managed to onboard channel partners as distributors. The company has outlined a strategic roadmap where they aim to offer embedded finance with built in crop insurance, export fresh produce, diversify their business model by marketing the findings of their data analytics to different stakeholders and own their own agri-input and machinery brand in the next few years. DeshiFarmer has received a mixture of grants and angel investment to assist the company in launching and kicking off its operations. The startup received $142,000 in grants from SwissContact, USAID and Banghabandhu Innovation Grant (BIG). The founders own collective investment amounted to $150,000 while angel investment totaled approximately $200,000.

records.title: Agroshift
records.description: Agroshift is a demand-driven digital grocery ordering platform for Ready Made Garments (RMG) factory workers and employees providing primarily agro commodities like vegetables, fruits, rice, pulses, milk, and meat, along with other daily needs. Agroshift envision to replace the intermediary in the supply chain and provide workers direct access to high-quality, safe, and affordable food. Workers can place digital orders through a mobile app or physically through ordering kiosks (containing fixed-mobile tablets) set up at designated places within the factories. Agroshift fulfill orders by procuring directly from their farmer networks located across 4 districts of Bangladesh, taking care of the sorting, grading, packaging, and delivery at factories. Agroshift partnered with Brac for mentorship and seed Fund through ‘Stitch challenge’. Their first customer is H&M- renowned global Ready Made Garment(RMG) sourcing company. They gave market exposure to different RMG factories. ADB provided Fund and international exposure. Agroshift partnered with UNDP’s Youthco lab, International Trade Center, Dhaka bank, USAID and swisscontact.

records.title: Fashol
records.description: Fashol is an end to end digitized agritech supply chain platform; by leveraging technology, they create a transparent and equitable marketplace that empowers farmers, establishes structure amongst traditional middlemen and provides a robust reliable supply of fresh produce to businesses.  As a result, the market forces in play provide consumers with fresher and more affordable produce. Retailers and businesses can rely on Fashol to ensure a consistent and reliable supply of fresh produce to their doorstep. Fashol's system optimizes delivery routes, reducing transportation costs and ensuring timely deliveries. The platform's capabilities include order forecasting based on historical data, enhancing the accuracy of deliveries.

_annotations.Digital Solution Type (Category & sub-ca: Digital Agrifood Services :: Value chains management
_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di: Over 2,000 farmers have gained direct access to urban markets through Fashol & 10,000 farmers are boarded onto the platform. 10M+ Fresh Produce Delivered. 600+ Regular SKUs. 5,000+ Retailer Network

records.title: Wegro
records.description: Wegro is aggregation of person to person (P2P) financing model. It sources fund from individual and institutions like Bank and Non bank Financial Institute (NBFI), assess credit worthiness of farmer, provide goods/input to farmers. They buy back crops.  Farmer are not worried about market or price. Wegro get commission of the profit earned from the investment at a predetermined rate. WeGro is an agri fintech, with a  motto: Investing in Agriculture, simplified. WeGro provides a mobile app platform (both Android and iOS) where users can facilitate finance for agricultural projects, such as cattle, poultry, fisheries, vegetables, etc. WeGro provides investment and guidance to smallholder farmers who are otherwise unable to access formal (almost 10 Million) financing elsewhere.  Additionally, farmers can also avail access to agricultural input and access to markets. All of the projects are insured, monitored, scrutinized and available for the financiers to visit.

Farmers are getting benefit of access to finance, quality input and market. With projects in remote areas in Bangladesh,  WeGro is working with over 4,200 farmers across 10 zones in the country.  The financiers receive a share of the profit and the ROI ranges from 16-24% annually.

records.title: Shobjigram
records.description: Shobjigram streamline and optimize the fresh produce supply chain in Bangladesh by leveraging smart technologies.  By using technology and a well-organized system, Shobjigram aims to make the fresh produce supply chain more efficient, reducing delays and waste. records.title: FarmCloud
records.description: The FarmCloud mobile application is integrated part of the Koltiva agritech and fintech ecosystem. Farmers and producers with active user profiles in KoltiTrace Management Information Systems from Seed to Table for Cocoa, Palm Oil, Seaweed, Rubber, Coffee, and many more natural ressources, can access the FarmCloud app with their registered FarmerID. FarmCloud provides a unique and unmatched access to Social, Environmental, and Economic data from producers, their farms and plantations, sustainability verification and certifications, sales history, procurement of agri-inputs, cashless payments, and digital loan applications. With FarmCloud, the farmer access live transaction receipts, price and product standard information, and climate smart agriculture advice. For Farmers certified with voluntary certification standards, the FarmCloud is a digital certificate that includes code of conduct, contracts, sales quota control, and annual inspection records.

records.title: Tonle Sap

records.title: Smart Farm Assistance
records.description: A Cambodian group called Agri-Economiser created Smart Farm Assistance, a water conservation app that can help reduce water consumption by 20% to 50%. The app is internet-based and also uses a short message service (SMS), making it incredibly convenient for farmers. A farmer can use the app to connect to and control a device set up in their field. Sensors are also set up to check soil conditions and the weather and control water systems. The device will send information to the farmer about the condition of their field, weather and crops, and if the farmer sees that their crops need water and no rain is coming, they can press a button and water systems will work automatically.

records.title: TaroWorks
records.description: TaroWorks is a mobile software platform used by field staff field extension officers and salesforce. The application offers off-line services including data management, analysis, business process creation and user administration. The software application can work in remote area offline with no connectivity, empowering field staff to create, edit, read/use data out of the Salesforce platform. The application  allows the user to geo-tag a specific location offline, take photos (e.g. of farmer beneficiaries), capture signatures and allow for barcode/QR code scanning (e.g. for tracking products). Additionally, TaroWorks can serve as part of the intervention to beneficiaries by allowing mobilie users to show training videos, agricultural best practices guides, etc.

Once registered, farmers can access scientists and agronomists for up-to-date information on technology and markets, develop a crop plan and monitor it using farm activity calendaring service. Farmers can save the progress of their crops and prepare for pests, weather and other events and access Agribuddy's market intelligence service for latest price information so you can plan your logistics better.

records.description: Chamka Digital Solution is a collaboration with Ministry of Agriculture Forestry and Fisheries / Bronx Technology, the Chamka mobile app is developed by Korean fund and was redesigned to respond to the movement restrictions and physical distance. App is built for rural farmers to help improve access to Information and Communication Technology (ICT) and farming techniques, provide extension services and technical support via an online chat messaging service that helps farmers connect to more suppliers and buyers. The Chamka app provides agriculture e-learning and technical advice on farming, offers remote and online extension services, and an eMarket platform for smallholders to sell their produce and for buying agricultural input supplies at better prices. Agricultural experts help farmers overcome technical challenges, offering advice on how to maintain their crops and how to respond appropriately to climate emergencies. This information is delivered via pictures, videos, voice and texts through the app. Input retailers use the Chamka app for the virtual marketplace platform to promote and post products to sell. Input suppliers can manage their products and receive sale orders directly from farmers. App allows farmers to get updated news related their business; early Warning System; technical material; access to technical experts through integrative platform; access to buy production inputs; access to virtual market to sell their products; and understand the profitability of their business

records.title: Crop Monitoring
records.description: Launched in 2019, the Crop Monitoring is a mobile app based solution which is a one-stop solution that integrates multiple types of data (crop health, weather conditions, crop rotation, field activities, elevation, soil moisture, and a host of other types) in one place. Near-real time field monitoring ensures timely detection of crop health issues, including heat/cold/water stress, diseases, pests, weeds, and more. Early-stage detection of these anomalies speeds up the decision-making process, allowing growers to save time, reduce costs, and increase yields. It also lets farmers to monitor crop performance, generate scouting reports, and mark problem areas in one place. Simultaneously plan immediate and long-term field activities, such as sowing, spraying, fertilizing, harvesting, and others in the calendar and monitor their progress.

records.title: Water Quality Monitoring System
records.description: FlexFloc, established in 2021, introduces an IoT-based water quality monitoring system accurately measures fish tank conditions using FlexFloc’s devices. This innovative solution enables real-time monitoring of water quality through mobile and web applications, providing users the flexibility to access anytime, from anywhere. The solution is based on the research regarding the fish farming production by engaging in an insightful interview process with aquaculture farmers. The solution involves attaching the device at the top of the fish tank, where sensors read, transmit, and display data across applications.

_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital: The solution provides customers with immediate access to water quality information, including historical data for pattern analysis, leading to optimized harvests and reduced labor. It significantly boosts aquaculture farming, leading to higher production, lower fish loss rates, and fewer water changes, resulting in an estimated 133% growth in net profit. FlexFloc not only aids in water management, farming knowledge, and record-keeping but also envisions future expansion into feeding management and a marketplace, offering a comprehensive lifecycle approach to fish production.

records.title: Animal identification and registration system (AIRS)
records.description: This digital application aims to promote export of livestock and livestock products in Mongolia. AIRS is also the foundation for addressing and managing animal health issues (including zoonoses) and facilitate exports. AIRS aims to quickly locate the origin of an animal and will also contribute to improving public veterinary services, disease surveillance and control of contagious disease by strengthening reliability of veterinary export certificates. This digital solution can have significant economic impacts on Mongolia, help addressing the environmental challenges linked to over-grazing and improve the Sanitary and Phytosanitary (SPS) situation in Mongolia, as well as disseminate good practices and ensure replicability.

records.title: Agrolli smartphone
records.description: The Agrolli app is a digital product designed to help local small farmers (especially fruit and vegetable producers) to monitor weather conditions, get regular crop-related information, market their products and improve their financial situation. The farmer can enter their farmland history, track the vegetables the farmer grows and sells, get information about various vegetables and fruits from the app. THe Agrolli will support farmers to build trust and inform consumers about their products’ quality. Agrolly main functions include: (i) Connect rural household farmers with the ability to exchange text and photos (ii) Real-time weather monitoring (text and visual); (iii) Provide Long-Term Weather Forecast (temperature and rainfall) ; (iv) Selection based on the forthcoming forecast; (v) Crop risk assessing by identifying weather problem area. The Agrolli app first pilot was launched in April 2020 in New York by young people from India, Brazil, Mongolia and Taiwan and received recognition by IBM's Tech for Challenge’s ‘Call for Code 2020’. the Agrolli’ smartphone application was selected as the ‘Best Innovative Product and Service’ during the Innovation Week 2021, which is the second start-up that received their award as a result of being part of virtual event in May 2021.

records.title: Blockchain based certification and meat factory operating system
records.description: FAO Mongolia in cooperation with the General Authority of Veterinary Services (GAVS) has developed a blockchain-based technology the “Certification and Meat Factory Operating System (MFoS)". The application is to be applied in all meat processing factories in Mongolia, starting with a successful initial testing done in April 2021 at the Bayandelger Food and Meat Processing Factory in Tuv aimag. With the new system, a meat certificate containing information on the meat origin and the health inspection is to be issued from the animal registration certificate. The certificate thus provide more transparent information and tracking possibilities for the end-users or consumers. Following the successful testing of the MFoS system, the new certificate is to be introduced by GAVS in stages to all meat processing factories in Mongolia.

records.title: LDD's IM Farm
records.description: LDD's IM Farm game is an online scenario software created by the Department of Land Development for farmers, students and the general public. The purpose is to provide real-time environment scenarios for farmers before they grow their crops. The game or scenario information include real information to simulate planting 12 crops such as rice, corn, cassava, sugarcane, soybean, rubber, oil palm, pineapple, longan, rambutan, durian and mangosteen. Simulation players can choose the location for planting a particular crop using a base map or choose from the photo map. The system retrieve the soil group map, land use conditions, and identify the suitable soil group type for a specific crop. The application also adds additional information on the location including soil types, soil property information, soil health data, weather information, cost of planting crops at the provincial level, Information on fertilizer use, fertilizer prices, economic and social information, plant diseases, animals, pests and insects. At the end of the game, the player will immediately know how many products they have produced, with calculated values for income-expensea and simulated profits or loss. This software game can be used with PC computers or Mobile phones or Tablet  supported by IOS and Android operating systems. The application is available both in English and Thai  languages.

records.title: Oil Palm Resource Information System (OPRIS)
records.description: The Oil Palm Resource Information System (OPRIS) is a precision agriculture based digital solution developed by the Malaysian Palm Oil Board’s (MPOB) Biology and Sustainability Research Division (BSRD). It's a GIS technology based solution which supports MPOB by mapping the location of Sustainable Palm Oil Clusters (SPOC) and Malaysian Sustainable Palm Oil (MSPO) Certification areas. OPRIS helps researchers identify the soil types, agro-climatic factors, and even potential suitable plantation areas. Most importantly, it helps monitor incidents of pests and disease infestations – disasters that could spell significant losses in production and revenue.

records.title: Smart Solar Irrigation System (SirriS)
records.description: Developed by Bangladesh's Center for Renewable Energy Services Limited (CRESL) and jointly funded by the Government of Bangladesh and World Bank, the Smart Solar Irrigation System (SirriS) is a sensors and mobile app based solar powered irrigation system, automating irrigation based on soil and crop data. It automatically controls irrigation based on the soil characteristics and crop type. The system can be monitored and controlled through a mobile or web app and a farmer can remotely control the irrigation system, said the product information. It reduces reliance on electricity and fossil based fuels and can be remotely controlled.

_annotations.Digital Solution Type (Category & sub-ca: Digital Agriculture :: IoT/Sensor controlled water management
_annotations.Name of supplier/developer: Government of Bangladesh and the World Bank Group
_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
1,000 pumps operated from central system
28000 Solar Panels
100 Projects Completed


Source: Developer website
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
Solar power irrigation reduces fossil fuel use, irrigation cost and carbon emissions because 75% of irrigation pumps out of 1.7 million in Bangladesh are run by diesel engines. 

It saves about 1,500 liters of water to produce a kilogram of rice. It will also cut pressure on electricity and wash away fertilizer due to possible overwatering during manual irrigation.

It reduces the waste of groundwater thus reducing adverse environmental impact as the majority of the irrigation pumps use groundwater. It also saves nearly 6 billion liters of diesel and 1500-megawatts of electricity per year if implemented nationwide.

Source: https://www.aa.com.tr/en/science-technology/creator-of-app-based-solar-method-hoping-it-becomes-irrigation-revolution-in-bangladesh/2516533#:~:text=The%20Smart%20Solar%20Irrigation%20System,system%2C%20said%20the%20product%20information.

records.title: FOSHOLI
records.description:
Developed by ACI Ltd., Fosholi is an android based mobile app and web based platform providing high quality resources and information on sustainable pest control and crop management to smallholder farmers in Bangladesh. It offers advisory on reducing checmical pesticide use, improving soil health, weather forecasts, and conserving water, contributing to sustainable agriculture. The solution also enhances crop yield, supportes climate change adaptation and improves livelihood through accessible and improved agricultural practices. 

Farmers can check the platform's database of answers to frequently asked questions and they can connect with an expert. The solution also offers a digital platform for input retailers to take orders and sell products, and for farmers to log their expenses and calculate their profit and loss. It sources information from other available services, such as Soil Resource Development Institute, Department of Agriculture Marketing.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
About 1,05,000 farmers from 4200 farmers club all around the 12 districts of the country are regularly getting relevant information and advisory service using Fosholi App.

Source: https://www.aci-bd.com/all-news/fosholi-to-promote-balanced-fertilizer-digitally.html
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
2.6 million users are currently registered with Fosholi App. The user base includes stakeholders, traders, DAE & NGO Officials, teachers and students.

records.title: Weather Index Insurance
records.description: Developed by IWMI, the Weather Index Insurance is a mobile and web based digital solution which disseminates weather patterns to smart phones of Bangladeshi farmers so they can plan their agricultural activities. IWMI has installed two measurements at a central location in the Dunumadalawa village, Ellawewa GND, to measure and forecast rainfall and temperature. The agro-economic advisories prepared in collaboration with the Department of Agrarian Development are also sent to the Farmers mobile phone twice a week. The Weather Index Insurance solution is very specific to the area, the season, crop and risk insured.

_annotations.Digital Solution Type (Category & sub-ca: Digital Agriculture :: Livestock management & animal health
_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
It has reached 16 districts of northern, southern, and eastern Bangladesh. Cumulatively since 2018, 421,767 smallholders had bought 574,527 policies through the four distribution models. The rate of sale accelerated rapidly. In the first year, 2018, farmers bought 171 policies. By 2022, this had risen to more than 359,000.

Source: Developer website
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
Many Bangladesh smallholders get three crops per year. By late 2022, the insurance had run for 15 cultivation seasons. The total crop value insured in this period was US$ 14,406,758. Sadharan Bima and GDIC collected premiums worth $770,235 and paid out $771,986 to 143,705 farmers.

records.title: Crop Diagnostics Application
records.description: Developed by mPower Social Enterprise Ltd. in partnership with Dhaka Ahsania Mission (DAM) and CARE Bangladesh and funded by USAID, the Crop Diagnostics Application is a smartphone based digital solution that helps farmers diagnose any problem in a crop especially pest and disease infliction. Once a farmer identifies the specific problem, the app then suggests associated curative measures for that problem. The solution has two main features 1) Image based diagnostic tool: The app contains information with real images about various diseases that can occur at different parts of the crop and 2) Offline accessibility: The app functions without internet. The Crop Diagnostics Application enables farmers easily diagnose any disease or pest attack by matching the photos in app and it also gives instant curative advice to farmer for that specific pest or disease attack.

records.title: GeoBis
records.description: Developed by mPower Social Enterprise Ltd. with funding from Netherlands Space Office (NSO), the GeoBis is a crop management advisory service for smallholder farmers to improve agricultural productivity. Using advanced crop model, spatial and weather data – GeoBis provides actionable advice to farmers including weather alerts (heat stress, cold stress, foggy weather etc.) and associated management practices. GeoBis has two main features 1) Crop model: Temperature based crop growth model automatically identifies growth stage of specific crop variety by analyzing air temperature and 2) Stress alert via SMS and voice message: Farmers receive the stress alert in the form of SMS and Voice Message even with their basic phones. The solution is supported by satellite image processing, the system identifies specific hotspots in crop fields that are deficient in growth. The service provides farmers with weather-sensitive seed to seed agricultural recommendations based on their crop, variety and growth stage.

records.title: Digi Cow
records.description: Grameenphone's partner company  VerseV Ltd. has developed a digital livestock management solution, Digi Cow, based on the internet of things (IoT) at a dairy farm in Purbachal. Digi Cow uses an IoT-enabled smart tag which attaches to a cow's body to continuously record and transmit data such as body temperature and behaviour patterns. The data is received on a smartphone app and analysed, allowing the user to monitor the livestock's health, such as ovulation periods, and detect health anomalies. This ultimately enables preventive measures to be taken as early as two days in advance, helping to stop the animal from catching any disease and spreading it around the farm.

records.title: Digital Haat
records.description: The Digital Haat is a web and mobile app based online marketplace for buying and selling cattle in Bangladesh organized by Dhaka North City corporation, e-Commerce Association of Bangladesh (e-CAB) and Bangladesh Dairy Farmers Association. During the corona period, the online sacrificial hut 'Digital Hut', which was launched for the first time in the past 2020, has also taken the initiative of selling animals online. records.title: Shrimp Farming BD
records.description: Developed by a private agritech CodeTree, Shrimp Farming BD is a mobile app based digital solution for the shrimp cultivators of Bangladesh with solutions to various farming problems, calculators and complete guidelines. It contains information on improved technologies - from pond preparation through to harvest - and has a calculator that farmers can use to work out the quantities of chemicals, feeds and other inputs they need for their pond. Also incorporated is a Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) page where users can find answers to common questions with a single click: and they can send specific technical questions to SAFETI specialists online and receive an answer back within hours. The app can also be used to post news messages, and a link to market prices is planned.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:

Under the COVID-19 conditions this year, it has been particularly valuable as a support to Bangladeshi smallholder shrimp and prawn farmers, and will serve them as a remote learning resource well into the future. 

Source: Developer website.

records.title: Weather4Farmers
records.description: Developed by Weather Impact Ltd, Weather4Farmers is a web and mobile app based digital solution which provides high-quality information with specific agro-weather information which is critical for farm management. It also agricultural advisories, detailed weather forecast for the coming 10 days, upcoming seasonal anomalies, etc. Currently, the Weather4Farmers app is being used in Bangladesh by more then 600 farmers and 60 agricultural extension officers in 5 districts (Khulna, Patukhali, Natore, Mymensingh and Sylhet). The app also include alerts concerning the start of the rain season and extreme weather. Farmers can pick the language of their preference; English or Bengali, which is the official language of Bangladesh. This translation is an additional benefit, which helps them in making the right decisions regarding farming activities, extreme weather mitigation and eventually an increase in their food production.

records.title: Right Haat
records.description: Right Haat is a mobile app and web based learning and sharing platform where farmers share their aquaculture related problems and seek solutions from experts and other farmers. It's a knowledge sharing digital platform helps in availability of good quality fish fry and fingerlings. Right Kind’s fieldteam collects orders from farmers, especially smallholderfarmers with smaller demand, and aggregates them. These fish fry and fingerlings are then procured in bulk from renowned hatcheries that have worked with WorldFish in the past and then transported in a pickup truck or a microbus closer to farmers’ locations. This is of great advantage to smallholder farmers, who otherwise would have had to order from a nearby nursery or hatchery and end up with varying quality fish fry and fingerlings.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
More than 50,000 fish farmers in south-west Bangladesh, more than 200 input retailers, and around 100 LEAF (local extension agent for fisheries) members have used Right Haat services.

Source: https://www.icsf.net/newss/bangladesh-right-haat-first-digital-aquaculture-platform/

records.title: Climate- and market-smart mung bean advisories (CAMASMA)
records.description: Developed by International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center (CIMMYT), CAMASMA is an interactive voice response (IVR) based weather forecast advisory service for Bangladeshi farmers through SMS and voice messages. Outbound Dialer based voice messages are sent to farmers 5 days before a heavy rainfall might occur, encouraging them to harvest their mungbean if ready. It also provides general advisory services on various topics for cultivation of mungbean as well as market price data. By integrating and disseminating weather-forecast information, climate-smart advisories for when and how to harvest mung bean help farmers to mitigate some of the climate risks associated with crop production. Both mung bean farmers and traders also benefit from real-time market price data. In addition to market intelligence on where large blocks of farmers have quality mung bean for sale, CAMASMA improves information flow to lower trading firms’ transactions costs while speeding farm-gate purchase and income generation from farmers.

records.title: Wheat Blast Early Warning System (EWS)
records.description: Developed by CIMMYT and rolled out in 2019, Wheat Blast Early Warning System (EWS) is a digital platform that notifies farmers and officials when weather conditions are ideal for the fungus to spread. A new digital early warning system can help farmers and scientists. It integrates mathematical models that, when combined with weather forecasts, can simulate disease growth and risks to provide an advanced warning about potential wheat blast outbreaks. With three years of data already recorded, the system — originally piloted in Brazil, where the wheat blast originated in 1985 — is being rolled out across Bangladesh to deliver real-time disease updates to extension workers and smallholder farmers via SMS and voice message. Data is analyzed for 17 sq km areas. The tool can also quantify projected amount of yield loss due to the disease. Weather info can be pulled from BMD or Dark Sky forecasts.

_annotations.Name of supplier/developer: International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center (CIMMYT)
_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
More than 6,000 extension agents in Bangladesh have already signed up for disease early warnings.

Source: https://www.cimmyt.org/news/preventing-and-protecting-against-wheat-blast/

records.title: Farmer Query System (FQS)
records.description: Farmer Query System (FQS) is a mobile app based remote consultation service where user (farmer or infomediary) can place queries. An agricultural expert (who searches queries on a web-based dashboard - often accompanied by a photo) provides an appropriate and unbiased recommendation via phone call and SMS to farmer’s phone. Another feature of the app is seed variety recommendation, which helps farmers decide which variety of seed will be most appropriate based on his/her specific need and circumstance, e.g. preferred season, soil condition, pattern of disease infestation in his/her location. Crop diagnostics is another feature that helps farmers diagnose any problem in a crop, especially pest and disease infliction. Once a farmer identifies the specific problem, the app then suggests associated curative measures for that problem. The seed variety recommendation and diagnostic features function offline.

records.description: Developed under AgriTT Research Challenge Fund-supported project, AgriApp is a mobile app based digital solution providing Cambodian farmers with access to agriculture and market related data to help them improve yields and income by making informed decisions. It enables two-way interaction with farmers, who can send their queries to agriculture experts through the service platform as well as share information. AgriApp includes a searchable database, geographic information linked to queries, training tools, and a question-and answer service and online feedback system. All these functions are useful for many areas of crop and livestock management: pest and disease management, variety/breed selection, market price information, weather and climate information, agricultural equipment, and input supplier information.

records.title: The Paddy Trading Platform (PTP)
records.description: The Paddy Trading Platform (PTP) is a mobile app based digital solution developed by Cambodia Rice Federation (CRF) in 2016. It was developed as part of the Support to Commercialization of Cambodian Rice Project (SCCRP) to establish and strengthen links between Farmer Organizations (FO) and private sector buyers of paddy rice in Cambodia in order for them to fulfill their roles as economic stakeholders in the rice value chain. The PTP is a business matchmaking solution that complements other instruments with the overall goal of assisting the growth of the rice value-chain in general, and specifically Cambodian farmers in realizing economic benefits from rice market development. This app is designed for millers, intermediaries, farmers, and agricultural cooperatives to use in order to make announcements, news, and see historical data all on a mobile device.

records.title: Digital platform to Digitize Tomato Value Chain
records.description: Digital platform to Digitize Tomato Value Chain is an Internet of Things (IoT) based greenhouse based digital solution which supports smart agricultural industry and specifically, digitizes tomoto value chains with the help of a mobile app. It helps in increasing the productivity and output, and ensure that the tomatoes produced are rich in juice, uniform in quality, size and taste, and full in grains. At present, the annual output of tomatoes per unit area in smart glass greenhouses is 6-8 times that of traditional greenhouses. Behind the high yield and high quality of tomatoes is the support of more than 2,000 "big data" collected in real time by this digital solution every day. There are 423 sensors and 1,165 controllers installed in the greenhouse which can collect data on temperature, light, water, gas and fertilizer in real time. The collected data is uploaded to the "Agricultural Brain" system, and the optimal solution is obtained after analysis for watering and fertilization.

records.title: Linying County Chili Internet of Things and Big Data Platform
records.description: Linying County Chili Internet of Things and Big Data Platform is an IoT based digital solution which helps farmers through technologies such as 5G, artificial intelligence (AI), and big data. The solution has installed rows of wireless sensors among local pepper plants which collect data on water, fertilizer, and soil conditions every 30 minutes and upload it to a data processing center managed by staff from Henan Yimin Co Ltd. After data processing, the center sends out instructions to farming equipment for automatic irrigating and fertilizing. Linying has also introduced 5G technology for better signal transmission to nearly 7,000 mu (466.7 hectares) pepper plants. It makes irrigating and fertilizing more precise and efficient. It provides farmers with 1) soil, weather and crops 2) intelligent detection and early warning system for pests and diseases, pesticides 3) reduces the waste of water resources and the pollution of chemical fertilizers and pesticides to the environment, making agricultural production more ecological, safe and environmentally friendly.

records.title: Digital Prodution System for Rice Planting
records.description:
Developed by China Agricultural University, the Digital Prodution System for Rice Planting is an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solution for the entire processes of rice planting and industrial chain. With more than 90 sets of various types of equipment, the solution realizes the data monitoring of people, farm machinery, equipment, crops, materials and environment and boosts efficiency of agricultural production by 30% and reducing production costs by 20%. The solution also automates transplanting, fertilizing, spraying pesticides and other farming activities (except for sowing)related to rice planting which saves time and money. 

The system has a huge LED screen which displays Internet of Things (IoT)  based real-time data monitoring in Dianjiang County. The agricultural Internet of Things transmits information such as moisture, temperature, and pests, and remotely controls drones to spray pesticides and automatic irrigation platforms. With the help of plant protection drones, the entire rice field is covered with atomized pesticides in just a few minutes.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
In 2024, the rice seed production area in Dianjiang County will reach 20,000 mu, with an estimated seed production of more than 4 million kilograms, and a direct output value of about 70 million yuan. In addition to being sold to some provinces and cities in the middle and upper reaches of the Yangtze River, the "Dianjiang-made" seeds have also been exported to some Southeast Asian and African countries. At present, the mechanized harvest rate of rice in Dianjiang County is 98%.

The agricultural Internet of Things transmits information such as moisture, temperature, and pests, and remotely controls drones to spray pesticides and automatic irrigation platforms. With the help of plant protection drones, the entire rice field is covered with atomized pesticides in just a few minutes.

In addition to being sold to some provinces and cities in the middle and upper reaches of the Yangtze River, the "Dianjiang-made" seeds have also been exported to some Southeast Asian and African countries. At present, the mechanized harvest rate of rice in Dianjiang County is 98%.

records.title: Traceability System of the Quality and Safety Information of Tongxin Ecological Chicken
records.description: The Traceability System of the Quality and Safety Information of Tongxin Ecological Chicken is a blochchain, Internet of Things (IoT) and mobile app based traceability, food safety and quality management digital solution for breeders and producers. With the help of a unique RFID (radio frequency technology) based foot ring token bound to each chicken foot, this QR code based traceability solution provides consumers with information about the chicken’s identity, covering its lairage time, slaughter time, and the cold-chain transportation. The QR code functionality also prevents dead livestock from reaching the market. It works in both online and offline modes and has reached sales revenue of more than 30 million yuan online and 11 million yuan offline in 2022. For poultry farmers, it provides the age and breeding ground of the chickens, the distance they walk every day, the air pollution index of the surrounding environment, the quality of drinking water, the quarantine time, the slaughter time and other details are all recorded in the blockchain. This digital ledger technology used for cryptocurrency transactions can now be fully used in poultry farming. The solution can be extended to cattle, sheep, pigs and other livestock in the future, and similar traceability systems can be applied to tomatoes or watermelons, etc.

records.description: Developed by Agrilife Technologies Pvt. Ltd., AgriBolo is a digital platform which is a mobile app and web based farm management and advisory solution that links farmers with several other stakeholders in the agricultural ecosystem. Farmers receive personalized crop advisory services, weather information, market linkages and financial services through this platform that improves agriculture productivity, reduce risks and enhance farmers’ livelihoods through data-driven insights and digital connectivity. records.title: CLASS (Crop Loss Assessment Support System)
records.description: Developed by Agrotech India, CLASS (Crop Loss Assessment Support System) is a digital solution for farm management which uses remote sensing technology and drones to assess crop yield and loss, analyzing data through millions of algorithms. It operates in both automated and interactive modes, facilitating the collection, storage, and processing of agricultural data. The system expedites crop insurance claims, reducing settlement time from 45 to 7 days. Through a mobile app, it provides farm advisory services on crop health, pest management, fertilizer use, and weather forecasts. CLASS also supports banks in digital crop assessment for loan verification and assists in water resource management projects, making it a useful tool for various stakeholders in the agricultural sector.

_annotations.Digital Solution Type (Category & sub-ca: Digital Agriculture :: AI-Big data based solutions
_annotations.Name of supplier/developer: Agrotech Risk Pvt. Ltd. - Joint venture between Trinity League India Limited and Ctrl2Go
_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
Has empowered 30,000-40,000 farmers in over 12 states

Source: https://www.niti.gov.in/sites/default/files/2023-03/Compendium-of-75-Agri-Entrepreneur-and-Innovators.pdf
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
In India, it has been used on more than 15 million hectares of agricultural land. The technology facilitates equitable insurance claims and loan processing by providing objective evaluations devoid of human intervention.

Crop loss claim settlement periods have been reduced by CLASS from 45 to 7 days. The Mahalanobis National Crop Forecast Centre has validated it for accuracy in crop loss assessment, GP-level crop yield estimation, and forecast outcomes. The yield estimating tool has been deployed in 50 districts over multiple states, covering items like rice, maize, wheat, cotton, and soybeans. More than 2,000 crop intelligence models are being developed by the business.

Source: https://www.niti.gov.in/sites/default/files/2023-03/Compendium-of-75-Agri-Entrepreneur-and-Innovators.pdf

records.title: CropAssure
records.description: Developed by BharatRohan Airborne Innovations, CropAssure is a seed-to-shelf crop management solution. It uses drone-backed precision farming techniques and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ensure residue-free and bountiful harvests for farmers and Farmer Produce Organisations (FPOs). CropAssure acts as a data-backed Decision Support System (DSS) with a preventive outlook, covering the entire crop cycle from soil-based cultivar selection in pre-sowing to post-harvest market linkage. It includes drone crop monitoring, on-farm implementation assistance, generation of advisories, and reduction of farming input efforts and costs. CropAssure is part of a suite of products by BharatRohan, which also includes SeedAssure and SourceAssure.

records.title: CultYvate
records.description: Developed by Farms2Fork Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (F2F), Cultyvate is an Internet of Things (IoT) and remote sensing-based precision analytics platform for farmers. It offers a full-stack digitization solution including hardware & software for Irrigation, Fertigation, and Polyhouse Automation. The system uses IoT sensors in the soil, IoT weather stations on the ground, and satellite-based remote sensing to collect data. Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms analyze this data to provide crop, soil, and climate-specific advisories for irrigation and fertigation management. The solution can either send advisories to farmers via mobile phones or operate systems automatically.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:

100+ Downloads

Paddy Production:

59% increase in farmers' net income

records.title: Farmers Fresh Zone (E-commerce Platform)
records.description: Developed by Farmers Fresh Zone Pvt. Ltd., Farmers Fresh Zone is an online 'fresh store' that delivers fresh fruits & vegetables (F&V) from the farm gate directly to customers' homes in less than 15 hours from harvest. The platform connects rural farmers with urban customers by integrating the market ecosystem with modern technology. It operates via a website and mobile app, enabling smooth and streamlined operations at both front-end and back-end. The platform features unit level traceability through a "know your farmer" feature, which stores data about the farmer responsible for growing the produce purchased by customers, ensuring transparency in the supply chain.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
2000+ farmers and more than 1 lakh (100,000)  customers

PlayStore App : 100K+ Downloads

Source: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.farmersFZ.farmersFZ
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
- Generated 200+ direct jobs
- Impacted 2000+ farming families
- Increased farmers' income by 15%
- Reduced wastage to less than 5 percent through demand forecasting and product planning
- Provided better prices to farmers for their yield irrespective of market price fluctuations
- Reduced food miles from 1200 km to less than 250 km, reducing carbon emissions
- Reduced average time from harvest to customer from 48 hours to 16 hours
- Annual turnover of INR 7.7 Crore
- Promotion of GAP farming resulting in higher quality yield
- Enabled urban customers to access safe-to-eat food, promoting health

records.description: Developed by Tradedoot Agriculture Marketing Solutions Private Limited, Kisan Saathi is a web and mobile app based digital platform acting as a one-stop solution for farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), agri-commodity buyers, and other participants across the agricultural value chain. Established in 2015, it addresses various agriculture-related needs including farm inputs, consultancy services, post-harvest practices, and output produce marketing. The platform focuses on strengthening FPOs through capacity building, technology transfer, improved post-harvest management, and efficient market linkages, aiming to create self-sustainability and better farm income realization.

records.title: Ninjacart B2B Agri-Marketplace Platform
records.description:
Developed by 63Ideas Infolabs Private Limited, Ninjacart is an Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled  mobile app and web based end-to-end agri marketplace that leverages technology to transform trade amongst farmers, traders, and retailers through tech-driven commerce, trade credit, and fulfillment solutions. The platform connects various agri-players, including farmers, resellers, retailers, consumers, and supply chain participants, enabling them to buy and sell fresh produce transparently while addressing structural problems such as information asymmetry, payment hassles, and distribution inefficiency. Ninjacart sources produce directly from farmlands and transports it to retail outlets and small businesses within 12 hours, ensuring longer shelf life and efficiency across the supply chain. 

Ninjacart's ecosystem includes several targeted products including 1) Ninja Mandi: Focused on traders for stock and price discovery, new sourcing opportunities, and trade credit 2) Ninja Kisan: Provides farming advisory, guaranteed payments, and deals on agricultural inputs for farmers 3) Ninja Kirana: Offers stock and price discovery, doorstep delivery, and trade credit for retailers and 4) Ninja Global: Likely focuses on international trade opportunities.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
8 Lakh+ Farmers
1 Lakh+ Retailers
20,000+ Resellers

Source: Developer website
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
86% of traders report a better quality of life
94% of traders reported growth in their business using credit
91% of traders have increased their income
76% of retailers report improved quality of life
81% of retailers have increased their income
79% of farmers report improved quality of life
79% of farmers say their earnings have increased
83% of farmers saw marked improvement in their way of farming

Source : Ninjacart Impact Report 2023

https://www.ninjacart.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/NinjacartImpactReport2023.pdf

records.title: nuture.farm
records.description: nurture.farm is a precision agriculture mobile and web based digital platform offering farm services, agri-input commerce, market linkages and farm advisory to bring about digital transformation & drive sustainability in agriculture. It has nurtured an integrated digital-first ag-ecosystem built on shared economy models, an active rural-gig economy workforce, and accessible technology for all. The platform also includes nurture.retail, a digital agri-input e-commerce platform for agri-retailers offering the largest digital catalogue of agri-input products at best prices, along with credit solutions to help retailers manage their cash flows and grow their businesses. The platform uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and remote sensing for customized recommendations. Nurture.farm targets smallholder farmers and agribusinesses from India. The app connects farmers with retailers, enables machinery rental, and enrolls them in sustainability programs for crops like rice, sugarcane, and maize.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
2.6 Mn farmers registered as users of the digital solution, as of 15 July 2024. Additionally, the solution serves 90,000 retailers and has serviced 10,688,312 acres. This information is displayed on the company's website as of 15 July 2024

Source: https://nurture.farm/

1M+ Downloads (Playstore)

records.title: Droneer Series - Enterprise Grade Agriculture Crop Spraying Drones
records.description: Developed by Trithi Robotics Private Limited, Droneer Series is a enterprise grade spraying drone for precision farming which uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) and mobile app which covers 2 hectares in a single battery & manages 40+ hectares in full day operations. It offers various drones including 1) Droneer One5: A 15.5-liter crop spraying drone 2) Droneer Three5: A 35-liter crop spraying drone for international markets 3) Multispectral Drone T3-MS: Specialized for crop monitoring in India and 4) Multispectral Thermal Drone T3-ALT: Advanced crop monitoring with thermal imaging capabilities in India. These drones feature advanced capabilities such as fast-charging batteries, wide spray coverage, terrain sensing, obstacle avoidance, and specialized sensors for crop health monitoring. The solution reduces harmful pesticide use, improve crop monitoring, and contribute to increased food production capacity globally.

records.title: GidaBits
records.description: Yuktix GidaBits is a crop management and protection solution that uses Internet of Things (IoT) devices and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to improve farm productivity and yield. The system provides real-time farm monitoring, disease and pest forecasting, irrigation management, and personalized crop advisory services. It provides data-driven, personalized, and affordable solutions for crop management, crop protection, and activity planning. The platform can be deployed using a grid model for multiple farmers or farm-specific deployments for more localized data collection.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
The system is live in multiple regions, reaching more than 1500 growers directly and over 10,000 farmers through partner organizations. 

Source: https://www.cabidigitallibrary.org/doi/pdf/10.5555/20220028109
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
20-35% reduction in water usage
20-25% reduction in crop loss due to insects and diseases
Up to 30% increase in overall crop production
Rainwater use efficiency increased to 60-70%
Reduced runoff by 30-40% and soil loss by 50-60%

Source: Developer website

records.title: TrulyDesi Organic Dairy and Farm-to-Consumer Platform
records.description: Developed by Gauecogram Agrovikas Producer Company Limited, TrulyDesi is a digital platform which support sustainable organic dairy farming with complete traceability and quality assurance. The platform connects farmers from rural India directly with customers, selling organic A2 milk and dairy products, certified organic groceries, and residue-free fruits and vegetables. TrulyDesi uses blockchain for traceability, Internet of Things (IoT) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) for cow management, and offers an omni-channel distribution framework including a mobile app, website, and retail partnerships.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
5000+ customers, 450+ subscribers of A2 milk, network of 15000+ farmers

Source: https://www.niti.gov.in/sites/default/files/2023-03/Compendium-of-75-Agri-Entrepreneur-and-Innovators.pdf
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
- 35% reduction in cost of production of milk, vegetables, fruits and organic grocery
- Higher selling margins for farmers while remaining affordable for consumers
- Reduced plastic waste through milk pouch recycling program
- Conservation and breeding of Indian cow breeds
- Improved soil fertility through sustainable farming practices

Source: https://www.niti.gov.in/sites/default/files/2023-03/Compendium-of-75-Agri-Entrepreneur-and-Innovators.pdf

records.title: Eggoz Nutrition
records.description: Developed by NUPA Technologies Private Limited., Eggoz Nutrition is a web based digital platform connecting egg producers with consumers in India. It utilizes technology to manage egg quality, nutrition, and supply chain logistics and facilitates direct farm-to-consumer delivery of eggs and egg-based products. Eggoz Nutrition implements quality control measures and uses specialized feed to produce eggs with enhanced nutritional profiles. The digital solution includes e-commerce functionality and supports traceability in egg production. It improves efficiency in the egg industry while providing market access for rural farmers.

Provides 24-hour farm fresh eggs to consumers, compared to industry standard of 5-7 days
11 safety checks including cleaning, UV Sanitization, and grading
100% purchase guarantee for farmers
Contributes to making India protein positive with standardized nutrition & safe herbal feed

records.title: AquaExchange (AquaX)
records.description: AquaExchange (AquaX) is a mobile app, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IoT) based digital solution which supports the inland shrimp and fish culture industry. It leverages IoT devices, direct market linkages, and a network of suppliers to support aquaculture farmers. The solution offers 24/7 monitoring and control, seamless market access, efficient procurement, and technical advisory services. AquaX increases productivity, profitability, and sustainability across the aquaculture ecosystem by eliminating receivables risk and facilitating access to formal financing.

records.description: FreshtoHome is a mobile app and web based vertically integrated e-commerce platform for fish and meat products. It uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) based technology to enable direct sourcing from fishermen and farmers, eliminating middlemen and reducing the coast-to-customer cycle to less than 24-36 hours. The platform delivers preservative-free fresh fish, seafood, and antibiotic residue-free poultry and meat to over 200 cities in India, handling more than 2.5 million orders per month.

records.description: Developed by HiMedia Laboratories Pvt Limited, Higronics is an Internet of Things (IoT) and cloud based mobile app solution which offers an end-to-end hydroponics automation system for controlled food production in urban India. The company provides comprehensive services from initial land surveys to ongoing farm management, as well as agronomic advice and operational consultations.

records.title: Doordrishti Platform
records.description: The Doordrishti Platform, developed by Dvara E-Registry, is a digital solution for Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) and farmers. It offers integrated farm services, analytics, and financial solutions by digitizing FPO activities and managing data on farmers, landholdings, and crops under cultivation. The platform provides insights on crop area, health, and stages, as well as agricultural input demand based on crop area, variety, and sowing dates. These features are designed to aid FPOs in business planning, inventory management, and credit utilization. For commodity procurement, FPOs can share purchase details with farmers through an app to assist in sales planning. The platform also delivers information on futures commodity prices, weather updates, and includes tools for tax filing and financial statement maintenance. Farmers can access customized crop advisory, credit linkages, weather updates, and price information through a mobile application. To ensure inclusivity, farmers without smartphones receive information via SMS. The platform also connects FPOs with agri-input suppliers, commodity buyers, and financial lenders, creating a holistic ecosystem for agricultural management and decision-making.

records.title: CRiMSA (Climate Risk Mitigation & Sustainable Agriculture platform)
records.description: Developed by Upaj, CRiMSA (Climate Risk Mitigation & Sustainable Agriculture platform) is a precision agriculture digital solution which integrates information from satellites, Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and soil biomarking to provide actionable insights across the farming lifecycle. The platform offers services in four key areas of fertilizer optimization, soil preservation, crop insurance and farmer credit access. CRiMSA utilizes artificial intelligence and machine learning to analyze agricultural data, enabling informed decision-making for stakeholders including farmers, financial institutions, and agribusinesses. The system's capabilities extend from loan facilitation to market linkage optimization, addressing both climate-related risks and sustainability challenges in agriculture. CRiMSA forms part of Upaj's broader ecosystem of agricultural technology solutions, which includes specialized tools for risk assessment, rural insurance, and real-time farm advisory services.

records.title: SeaCombine Technology platform
records.description: Developed by Sea6 Energy Pvt. Ltd., SeaCombin is an Internet of Things (IoT), sensors and Big Data based seaweed cultivation technology. It is mechanized catamaran system enables simultaneous harvesting and replanting of seaweed in deep ocean waters, allowing for large-scale, cost-effective seaweed production. It supports ocean farming by making it possible to cultivate seaweed in previously inaccessible areas. The platform includes custom workboats, specialized seaweed handling equipment, and marine agronomy tools. It reduces labor costs and allows for seaweed farming in nutrient-rich deep ocean waters, surpassing conventional shallow-water farming methods. The SeaCombine or Sea ‘tractor’ is a technology that can seed, harvest and handle harvested seaweed at the same time, mechanizing seaweed farming through and through and allowing farmers to farm larger areas of the ocean surface. While initially designed for deep ocean use, the technology has evolved to include smaller mechanized vessels suitable for medium-to-shallow waters, adapting to various coastal conditions.

Reduces labor costs in seaweed farming
Enables farming in deep and exposed waters
Allows for seaweed farming anywhere in the oceans
Monitors ocean parameters and sea plant health
Ensures high seaweed quality
Provides complete traceability of products

Source: Developer website

records.title: Food Traceability Platform (TraceX)
records.description: TraceX's Food Traceability Platform is a blockchain enabled cloud based mobile app solution which supports food and agri supply chains, making them trustable, traceable, and transparent. It offers end-to-end traceability from farm to fork, enabling stakeholders across the supply chain to monitor, track, and report on various metrics, including ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) factors. It caters to multiple industries within the food sector, including agribusiness, food processors, and various crop types. Trace Gro and Trace Pro provide end to end traceability covering the pre-harvest and post-harvest management of the entire food supply chain. The solution enables tracing the origin of products, monitoring the production practices and tracking the handling and transportation. This enables better management of quality, safety and sustainability aspects throughout the supply chain.

records.title: CropSnap
records.description:
CropSnap is a mobile app based crowdsourcing platform for rapid and improved crop verification and validation of field crop production. It specializes in geospatial data acquisition, data fusion, analytics, and mapping services for agricultural, global ecosystems, and other weather-sensitive applications. The platform integrates data from satellite and ground sensors with sophisticated weather and climate models for customized applications. CropSnap is used to gather crop statistics along with photos and videos to aid in crop yield assessment, crop health monitoring, and crop classification. The app is built for resilience, offering features where users can record measurements in "zero" connectivity environments without losing critical data. CropSnap performs asynchronously, syncing and maintaining the state of the data transfer to the cloud without manual intervention.

CropSnap offers a range of services including Crop Acreage, Smart Sampling, Crop Health Monitoring, Yield Forecasting and Yield Estimations.

records.title: DGV Pay
records.description: Developed by Digivriddhi Technologies Private Limited (DGV Group), DGV Pay is mobile app and web based integrated dairy fintech and marketplace platform. It simplifies payments for the dairy ecosystem by providing door-step banking services for farmers and milk societies. As part of the larger DGV platform, it's a one-stop solution for all financial and non-financial needs of India's dairy farmers. DGV Pay enables seamless access to banking services at milk collection points, working alongside DGV Money for customised financial products and DGV Connect for an integrated marketplace with embedded financing options. DGV Pay is part of a larger DGV ecosystem that includes 1) DGV Money: Offers customized financial products for dairy farmers and 2) DGV Connect: An integrated marketplace providing access to high-quality dairy input products and services with embedded financing options.

records.title: AquaFoundry
records.description: Developed by Cerebronics Technology Pvt. Ltd., AquaFoundry is an end-to-end automation system for aquaponics farming. It combines Internet of Things (IoT)-based monitoring, cloud-based management, AI-powered analytics, and robotics to create a fully automated and efficient aquaponics farm. The system includes sensors to monitor various parameters like pH, temperature, light, turbidity, and humidity, uploading data to the cloud for analysis. It features an Aquaponics Resource Planning (ARP) cloud application for remote farm monitoring and control, with alert and notification systems. The platform also integrates AI for predictive algorithms on disease, pest, growth, and harvest detection, and includes mobile robotics for tasks like image capture, transplantation, disease treatment, and harvesting.

_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
AquaFoundry enables year-round farming regardless of climate conditions, minimizes food loss to parasites, reduces water consumption, and accelerates plant growth rates. It allows for efficient production of both plant and fish crops in a controlled environment, potentially addressing food scarcity issues.

records.title: CropCare (Farm Geofencer API)
records.description: Developed by Prakshep Private Ltd., CropCare is an Artificial Intelligence (AI) enabled and web based suite of APIs to automate farm geofencing and provide farmers with digital farm management. records.title: nurture.farm
records.description: nurture.farm is an Internet of Things (IoT) enabled mobile and web based digital platform offering farm services, agri-input commerce, market linkages, and farm advisory to bring about digital transformation & drive sustainability in agriculture. It has nurtured an integrated digital-first ag-ecosystem built on shared economy models, an active rural-gig economy workforce, and accessible technology for all. The platform also includes nurture.retail, a digital agri-input e-commerce platform for agri-retailers offering the largest digital catalogue of agri-input products at best prices, along with credit solutions to help retailers manage their cash flows and grow their businesses.

records.title: Microsoft-ICRISAT Sowing Application
records.description: Microsoft-ICRISAT Sowing Application is an Artificial Intelligence (AI), cloud and Big Data based digital solution developed through a partnership between Microsoft, the International Crops Research Institute for the Semi-Arid Tropics (ICRISAT), and the Government of Andhra Pradesh, India. It uses AIand machine learning to provide personalized sowing advisories to farmers via SMS in Telugu. The app combines weather forecasting models with historical climate data to determine the optimal sowing time for crops, particularly groundnut. It's part of a larger initiative that includes a Personalized Village Advisory Dashboard for government officials to manage agricultural programs at scale.

records.title: Unmiti
records.description: Unmiti is a Software-As-A-Service (SaaS) based mobile application that combines ground data and remote sensing technology to track, monitor, and quantify agricultural production activities. It enables tracking and monitoring of farmers and farmlands, offering key features such as farm data collection, risk assessment using satellite-derived indices like NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) and NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index), and the analysis of critical agricultural indicators. With its alert and advisory dissemination system, Unmiti provides actionable insights to stakeholders, helping to mitigate risks and optimize farm productivity. Operating across 13 countries, the platform serves farmers, agribusinesses, and government agencies, supporting more efficient and informed agricultural decision-making.

records.title: Meri Saheli Platform
records.description: Developed by Frontier Markets, Meri Saheli Platform is an open-source phygital (physical + digital) solution to connect companies with rural customers in India. It features a vernacular, voice-enabled e-commerce application specifically for rural women entrepreneurs (Sahelis) and includes digital marketing tools such as an Artificial Intelligence (AI) chatbot for direct customer engagement. It offers product basket to meet various rural needs and supports a robust distribution network with local warehousing and doorstep delivery. Additionally, it provides data collection and analytical capabilities for market insights and training and capacity-building programs for rural women. The platform, designed by rural women for women, enables rural women in India to build economic resilience and growth by acting as an assessment tool, training tool, awareness tool, and marketplace, connecting solutions to people via partnerships with innovative solution providers.

_annotations.Number of users or subscribers of the Di:
35,000+ Saheli's (rural women entrepreneurs)
500,000 Customers

Source: https://www.frontiermkts.com/
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
The Meri Saheli Platform facilitates access to products and services for over 500,000 customers in 4,000 villages through a network of 35,000 women entrepreneurs (Sahelis). The platform has enabled the sale of 50 million products and generated an average annual net income of INR 65,000 per woman entrepreneur. It supports rural households, resulting in INR 11 billion in net earnings and savings. The platform has distributed over 4 million solar solutions, contributing to a reduction of 2.5 million tons of carbon emissions. It impacts 3.5 million beneficiaries and demonstrates significant economic and environmental contributions.

Source: https://www.frontiermkts.com/our-impact

records.title: S4S: Procurement and Processing
records.description: Science for Society Techno Services Pvt. Ltd., S4S offers is an Internet of Things (IoT) enabled web based solution for procurement and processing of agricultural produce, managed by women entrepreneurs. It addresses food supply chain issues, such as high post-harvest losses and inefficiencies from multiple intermediaries, by streamlining farm-gate sourcing and processing. It reduces middlemen, cuts margin leakages, and lowers logistics costs, while enhancing supply chain efficiency through energy-efficient practices and end-to-end traceability. By supporting farmers with additional income opportunities and promoting gender equality, S4S is in the commercial stage and serves both institutional customers and individual farmers. The platform incorporates the Solar Conduction Dryer (SCD) technology, a solar-powered food dehydrator that preserves produce for up to 1 year without chemicals or preservatives. S4S addresses issues in the agri-food supply chain, reduces post-harvest losses, and provides quality food ingredients to institutional customers while suppoting farmers and women entrepreneurs.

records.title: FishGo
records.description: Developed by an Indonesian agritech, Fish Go PT., the FishGO is a navigation-based mobile app to help the traditional fishermen to get higher catch rate which impacts their income and increases their quality of life in the long run.
