records.description: Developed jointly by PT XL Axiata Tbk (XL Axiata) and Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries Research and Observation Center (BROL), the Laut Nusantara is a digital solution which shows the location of the fish in the sea and facilitate the work of fishermen. In addition, it also has digital marketing tools which increase the sales of processed marine products produced by fishing communities. Laut Nusantara enables fishermen to plan their fishing activities better, start independently determining the closest fishing location, estimate fuel needs, and estimate the selling price, taking into account weather and wave conditions while working at sea. According to the Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries Research and Observation Center (BROL), the solution has over 62,000 active users/ subscribers and over 250,000 fishermen have benefited from it in 105 villages across 28 regions of Indonesia.

records.title: eGis Mapping
records.description: Developed by E-Komoditi, the eGis Mapping is a web and mobile app based digital solution which shows the spatial distribution of identifiable earth surface features using remote sensing and satellite imagery. It provides an informational description over a given area, rather than a data description. Image classification is the process used to produce thematic maps from imagery. The themes range from soil, vegetation, and surface water in a general description of a rural area, to different types of soil, vegetation, and water depth or clarity for a more detailed description. It is implied in the construction of a thematic map from remote-sensing imagery that the categories selected for the map are distinguishable in the image data.

records.title: ENVi
records.description:
Developed by IRGA Digital Sdn. Bhd., the ENVi is a smart weather station for capturing agronomic & climate data. It's s a multi-sensor IoT weather station for capturing material environmental data on the conditions of crops in the field. Using a combination of weather and soil sensors, ENVi picks up information on wind movement, lighting exposure, ground pH levels and a host of other pertinent climate insights to enable planters and farmers to better plan for planting and harvesting activities. 

ENVI's main features include 1) Water & Irrigation Management: guage rain and soil moisture levels, enabling better watering and irrigation practices which save time, money and resources 2) Soil Fertility Detection: guage the fertility of the soil to determine the best time to administer and replenish nutrient content 3) Harvest Planning: determine the best time for harvesting using localised weather information to predict plant maturity 4) Seeding Logistics: use data on temperature and soil moisture levels to determine the best time and location for seeding and 5) Pesticide Application: understands wind movements to ensure the most effective spread for pesticide spraying.

records.title: Food Market Hub
records.description: Food Market Hub is a cloud based procurement and inventory system which solves human error during the procurement process and inefficiency in inventory management. The system assists restaurants in forecasting raw ingredient purchases and recommended usage through analysis of weather reports and historical data using Artificial Intelligence (AI). It's main features include 1) Procurement: ordering user interface to place orders with suppliers and added up into inventory. Users can also monitor purchase activities and be alerted on unusual purchasing behavior 2) Inventory: recording inventory count, set reminders to count inventory, and be alerted to place an order when running low in inventory 3) Messaging: chat directly with suppliers or customer by attaching an order to quickly communicate. It also provides an indicator on each message sent, so that users know whether message has been delivered to or read by the recipients.

records.title: MyAgriTECH
records.description: Developed by ThinkerSpace Malaysia, the MyAgriTECH is an Internet of Things (IoT) based solution to monitor, control and assist agricultural operations. It offers some features such as an irrigation control system, crop monitoring system, fertilizer mixing system and weather observation system. It consists of two main components: 1) Input sensors for data collection and 2) Output controller responsible for managing devices such as pumps and valves. Once the data is collected by the sensors, it is seamlessly transmitted over the internet using wireless communication. This data is then securely stored in a cloud-based database, enabling real-time online monitoring and control systems. Through a dedicated website and mobile app, users have the convenience of monitoring and managing the plant’s condition at their fingertips.

records.title: PrakopAlert mobile app
records.description: Developed by International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development (ICIMOD), the Prakop Alert app provides flash flood and weather forecast information for Nepal. It's key features include 1) Accurate and reliable data: uses data from the High-Impact Weather Assessment Toolkit (HIWAT) and the Flash Flood Prediction Tool (FFPT) 2) Forecast information: 2 days of forecast information provided at every hour. Displays weather information such as temperature, rainfall, lightning, hail and wind. River discharge information is available for 12,428 river segments in Nepal and 3) Location based forecast: Provides forecast at municipality level, allowing users to search and access weather information for their desired municipalities. For river discharge information, users can select rivers within desired municipality using geographical maps. The app is available in two languages; English and Nepali.

records.title: Mizani app
records.description: Aria Technologies has developed ‘Mizani', an app-based loan appraisal and digital payment platform that addresses the issue of data shortage in processing credit for agriculture. The mobile platform uses different parameters and criteria specific to agriculture to generate a credit score for smallholder farmers to access loans. Mizani has now expanded its team and is discussing with two financial institutions for potential business contracts. Mizani aggregates digital profiles of the farmers, apply analytics for financial and technical assessment, and tell the bank how much creditworthy the applicant is. By helping credit appraisal, Mizani simplifies and accelerate the agriculture loan appraisal and optimize risk-profiling for banks. It helps farmers forge an economic identity even for those previously unbanked offering smallholder farmers a pathway to financial inclusion.

records.description: AirNex is an agtech startup which improves crop yield by providing crop insights through deep-tech and targeted application. records.title: SLIDE
records.description: Developed by iAPPS Ltd., SLIDE is an integrated fintech platform that enables supply chain stakeholders to gain access to capital by using data collected within the ecosystem to generate a reliable Artificial Intelligence (AI) based credit score for quick loan approval. The platform facilitates lending from financial institutions, impact investors or through crowdfunding, and mitigates risks by establishing a closed-loop supply chain. SLIDE uses and AI chatbot, secure QR for payment and traceability and an eWallet to facilitate transactions. Revenue is generated through platform fees and transaction fees.  Farmers can use the platform to apply for loans, arrange payment and collection, and find up to date price information, thereby maximising the value of their harvests. Traders use the platform for loans, crowdfunding and to improve traceability. Lenders benefit from KYC data, AI Credit Scores, and to manage their loans more effectively.

records.title: Crabifier
records.description: Developed by De La Salle University, Crabifier is a mobile application that identifies to species a juvenile mud crab by analyzing the shape of its carapace. It is useful of mud crab farmers and traders in detecting preferred species for grow out and validating the pricing of crablets for sale. CRABIFIER is based on a problem-solving system that uses image analysis and genetic marker technology to look for discrete visual differences in organisms that are hard to identify. The system is transformed into a mobile application using convolutional neural networks that can quickly do the identification on the field at the touch of a button. The system is currently used for juvenile mangrove crabs but can eventually be used for any organism at any developmental stage, dependent on the needs of the user. The identified reference images are processed using convolutional neural networks and transformed into CRABIFIER app. CRABIFIER has been field-tested in fish ponds and fishermen communities in Binangonan, Zambales and in Buguey, Cagayan, trainings of fishermen on the use of the app have also been held.

_annotations.Name of supplier/developer: De La Salle University's PRACTICAL GENOMICS LABORATORY (PGL)
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
Crabifier has worked with five farmers and is set to be tested in the mud crabs farms of Cagayan, Bataan and Iloilo to showcase its current state of accuracy and mobility. Interested parties from local governments, trade schools and state universities have also signified their interest in learning about the technology.

A new project involving Crabifier seeks to democratize the use and development of such technologies through a training program that will teach members of local governments, state high schools and universities, and agriculture and aquaculture stakeholders that basic principles of DNA barcoding, image analysis and programming. This targets the creation of a national network knowledgeable in the use of the technique and involved in the discussions and movements towards the modernization of Philippine agriculture and aquaculture practices.

Source: https://directory.growasia.org/crabifier/

records.title: AutoMonPH
records.description: AutoMonPH is an IoT-based decision support tool for irrigation scheduling and carbon footprints labeling that communicate with water level sensors using wireless connectivity. It's developed by scientists at International Rice Research Institute (IRRI) and the Philippines Rice Research Institute (PhilRice) in partnership with the Department of Agriculture, Philippines. AutoMonPH provides a platform of information sharing for efficient water management; real-time monitoring and reporting; verification of water management practices; multi-stakeholder interaction; and reduction of transaction times and cost of effective coordination amongst stakeholders. AutoMonPH is based on a scientifically proven method for irrigation called alternate wetting and drying (AWD) that improves water productivity and management.

records.description: Developed by Philippine Rice Research Institute (PhilRice), Leaf Color Computing Application (LCC) is a mobile app based digital solution which is used to determine the N fertilizer needs of rice crops. records.title: AgRiDOC
records.description: Developed by Philippine Rice Research Institute (PhilRice), AgriDOC is a mobile app and tablet based farm management solution for Filipino rice farmers, researchers, and extension workers. It improves the efficiency of farm management and rice crop production activities. Moreover, with its colorful user interface, modern illustrations, and icons, AgriDOC App also demonstrate to Filipino youth that rice farming can be exciting, modern, and attractive. AgriDOC lets farmers 1) view farm lots through satellite images from Google Maps 2) Keep track of all farm activities and expenses 3) Receive reminders about priority needs of rice crops during every crop stage 4) Plan and manage farm with farmer's family or farm manager by sharing farm activity data. AgriDOC app also provides information and knowledge links to help users make informed decisions on the care of their rice crops. Through its Rice Crop Insights, the app informs the user about the priority needs and concerns of rice plants for every crop age and growth stage. It contains basic recommendations on rice crop management practices from the PalayCheck System, and comprehensive information about released rice varieties. It also provides links to rice knowledge banks and other useful websites.

records.title: Automatic Drip Irrigation System (DIS)
records.description: Developed by Philippines Rice Research Institute (PhilRice), the Automatic Drip Irrigation System for vegetables is a sensors and mobile app based digital solution. The solution has solenoid valve and soil moisture sensors to capture information for farmers. The sensors detect soil moisture content and open/close solenoid valves based on thresholds set and then sends alert in smartphone and can be operated manually by app.  Automatic DIS provides real-time information on when and how much to irrigate farms. It measures soil moisture levels using a pre-defined moisture range, and analyzes which areas need water. If it detects that the soil is dry, the system opens the valves to start irrigating the plots. Water flows from a water tank through the pipes installed. If the soil is wet enough, the dripping stops. Powered by solar energy, it has two modes: auto and farmer. In auto mode, the system becomes fully automatic and decides when, where, and how much water to release. Farmer mode allows the farmer to command the system through SMS.

_annotations.Digital Solution Type (Category & sub-ca: Digital Agriculture :: IoT/Sensor controlled water management
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
16-35% without compromising yield

Source: Developer website

records.title: Intelligent Vineyards Platform
records.description: Developed by TELOFARM Inc., the Intelligent Vineyards Platform is a Internet of Plants (IoP) based digital solution which monitors the whole vineyard system over entire seasons and offers viticulturists and winemakers valuable insight into the health of their vines. The solution uses technology based on semiconductor process to measure the vines sap flow rate with minimum invasiveness to the plant. The sap flow rate represents the plant’s response to its environment, like the blood pressure and heartbeat of a person. This signal is wirelessly collected with soil moisture, and weather data, and integrated into our digital data network and software. The Intelligent Vineyards Platform can precisely monitor and manage the stress level of the vines within a determined window to achieve quality objectives, increase yields, and manage limited resources. It provides real time data directly to farmer/agri manager's phone tracking and archiving various events such as first rise of water, bud break, frost events, disease pressure (PMI INDEX), water and heat stress.

records.title: ClimateWatch App
records.description: ClimateWatch is a mobile app based digital solution which has been launched in 2023 in collaboration with the Vanuatu Meteorological and Geohazards Department (VMGD) within the Ministry of Climate Change, the Climate and Oceans Support Programme in the Pacific, the Australian Bureau of Meteorology, and EarthWatch. It understand how changes in temperature and rainfall are affecting the seasonal behaviour of plants and animals and to aid the monitoring of traditional knowledge indicators in Vanuatu such as turtles, plants, and animals. These indicators have been used by ni-Vanuatu (a large group of closely related Melanesian ethnic groups native to the island country of Vanuatu) for centuries to predict the weather patterns and behaviours. The ClimateWatch App addresses the challenges of monitoring all 80 islands spanning a total of 1,300 kilometres through its Citizen Science digital approach which means that anyone and everyone can be a part of it.

records.title: Digital Farmhand
records.description: Developed in 2018 by engineers of University of Sydney, the Digital Farmhand is a modular low-cost platform designed to assist smallholder farmers in improving their productivity and yields, and ultimately provide a more reliable income amidst changing markets and climates. It is a small electric tractor-like vehicle that can tow a variety of implements such as seeders, weeders and bed preparation tools. The Digital Farmhand can also use accessible smartphone technologies along with Artificial Intelligence (AI) to provide crop analytics such as yield estimation, pest and disease identification, as well as precision automation of many labour intensive farm tasks, e.g. weeding, spraying and seeding. After field trials in 2018 in Fiji and 2019 in Samoa, the platform is being used by smallholder farmers in the two states.

records.title: Samoa Weather
records.description: Developed by Samoa Meteorology Division, the Samoa Weather is a smartphone application which provides weather forecast and disaster advisories and warning information from Samoa Meteorology Division (SMD) so that the users can take early actions to reduce the impact by potential disasters. It helps local farmers in better planning their crop production and adopt to climate change. Climate extremes and climate-driven pest and disease negatively impact agricultural production and rural livelihoods and therefore informed advisories, alerts and robust early-warning generated by Samoa Weather are very helpful for farmers and rural dwellers to prepare for and adapt to changes in climate. It provides 1) Weather forecast with icons (Updated every 6am and 5pm) 2) Earthquake information severe than magnitude 6 3) Felt earthquake information in Samoa (regardless the magnitude) 4) Warnings for heavy rain, cyclone, and tsunami 5) The time of sunrise and sunset, moon phase, high and low tide of the day and 6) Climate information (e.g. Drought index for forest fire caution).

records.title: QConut mobile app
records.description: Developed by Ministry of Forests in Fiji and the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Forests in Tonga, QConut is a mobile geospatial application for promoting sustainable and climate-smart Pacific Island agricultural landscapes. records.title: Chipsafer
records.description: Chipsafer is an GPS enabled and sensors based digital platform that can track and early detect anomalies in cattle behavior completely remotely and autonomously. The animal wears a self-recharging device that transmits information about it to our servers for processing and analysis. With chipsafer the farmer can know where his animals are at all times and receive warnings if an anomaly is detected or if an animal trespasses a specified perimeter, which enables the detection of diseases on time and combats cattle theft. The farmer also receives actionable information about the livestock performance to better manage the herd. Chipsafer’s farm management software allows farmers to manage their herds. They can see the animals, where they have been, how much they walked per day, and get their whole genealogy. They can also register sales and purchases.

records.title: UMITRON
records.description: UMITRON is an Artificial Intelligence (AI) and IoT-based aquaculture solution for farms to optimize their feeding practices thereby lowering their costs and preventing waste and damage to the environment. Its technology stack includes solar-powered IoT devices that are deployed on aquaculture farms in the ocean to film fishes and measure patterns in their behavior using computer vision. Through machine learning algorithms the solution can detect when fishes are hungry, and automatically release feed for them. It also leverages satellite imagery to augment these insights by providing information about the temperature of the sea. The devices process the data using edge computing and compress them on-site to enable the transfer of data back to the shore with limited bandwidth. Additionally, it determines how much power it will be able to collect from solar energy based on weather forecasts.

records.title: TerraviewOS
records.description: TerraviewOS is a web and mobile app based unified vineyard management platform which consolidates various aspects of vineyard management into a single, user-friendly platform. It improves operational efficiency and offers data-driven insights for enhanced vineyard management. Using Artificial Intelligence (AI), historical data and real-time information, the solution helps farmers in more accurate yield estimates, supporting decisions to optimise production. The advanced soil moisture monitoring component minimises water use (optimises water use by up to 50%), optimise yields and improve fruit quality. It also provides accurate & reliable forecasting to keep farmers one step ahead of disease outbreaks, whether it is powdery mildew or botrytis. It reduce crop loss by up to 10%. TerraviewOS also identify exact locations of grapevines being affected by macro and micro nutrient deficiencies resulting in loss of yield. It also provides real time alerts to monitor all key elements of the vineyard; from micro climate to disease outbreaks. Finaly, it provides accurate micro weather forecast to help farmers prepare for oncoming events & make the right decisions.

records.title: Permia Sensing
records.description: Permia Sensing is an IoT based mobile application which provides a field-testing service to detect Red Palm Weevil (RPW) larvae growing in coconut palm trees. This insect is known to damage an estimated 10% of the coconut yield in the World, which is around £450 million per year. The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) has declared RPW as a global threat to the food industry because it has attacked about 40 palm species in 60 countries. Chemical treatments are effective if RPW can be detected within the first 2-weeks of infestation. Permia Sensing's field tested Internet of Things (IoT) was developed at the Morph Lab of Dyson School of Design Engineering, Imperial College London in the UK, a World Top 10 University.

_annotations.Digital Solution Type (Category & sub-ca: Digital Agriculture :: Pest and disease management

records.title: CultivateX
records.description: CultivateX is a mobile app based platform developed by the International Water Management Institute, Fruit and Vegetables for Sustainable Healthy Diets (FRESH), in collaboration with the CGIAR Initiative on Climate Resilience (ClimBeR) which provides real-time climate information and agronomic advisories to Sri Lankan farmers straight on their mobile phones. This is enabled by good digital infrastructure, including mobile phone penetration, usage, internet coverage and the high level of farmers’ literacy. On a pilot scale, 75 farmers received context-specific local weather alerts twice a week (at intervals of 3-4 days) and weekly agronomic advisories throughout the cultivation season. The provision of weather and agronomic advisories was designed to build the farmers’ climate resilience and capacity to understand climate variation and enhance knowledge of recommended agronomic practices.

_annotations.Name of supplier/developer: International Water Management Institute (IWMI) and Consultative Group on International Agricultural Research (CGIAR)
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
Samaraweera, Kulatunge and Jinasena are three tomato farmers aged 48-55 in Balangoda area. During the 2023 dry season, Kulatunge and Jinasena received climate advisories through a family member’s phone and from his friend, respectively. All three farmers mentioned that the climate advisories provided were accurate and guided them to decide the appropriate days for fertilizer and agrochemical application (rain-free days to avoid washaway) to make use of limited resources efficiently.

Ratnasiri is a 74-year-old experienced farmer cultivating 0.25 acres of land in the same area said the weather forecasts he received helped him to plan 3-4 days ahead, including the hiring of labor and off-farm work. This has helped to save LKR 6,000-8,000.

Silva confirmed that climate and agronomic advisories helped her to save money by applying the right inputs at the right time and deciding the right labor requirement, saving LKR 4000.

A 41-year-old farmer said that the agronomic advisories helped him to identify many pests and diseases correctly and that he shared the messages received to his phone with many of his friends.

Source: Developer website

records.title: Yara FarmCare: A Farming App
records.description: Developed by Yara International ASA, Yara FarmCare is a mobile app based digital solution which provides farmers with timely advice on when and how to spread and spray fertilisers effectively, based on their location, soil type, and hyperlocal weather conditions. It also provides Digital Leaf Color Chart (DLCC) which helps in comparing color of leaves with the color panel of the DLCC tool on farmer's phone, and let app analyse nitrogen levels and assist them in managing their crop through timely nitrogen application. DLCC helps farmers make informed decisions about fertilisation for optimal growth and maximised yields.

records.title: Farmto
records.description: FARMTO is a web based digital trading and marketing platform for farmers and consumers which allows product portfolio management. Its an agricultural product sales channel that connects farmers and consumers through a "share ownership of agricultural products" method, so that both can help and take care of the produce together if the consumer needs it. It helps consumers to visit the produce and check the coordinates of the planting area in the system. Consumers can book produce which farmers deliver during harvest season at their registered address.

records.title: FarmWeather
records.description: Developed by YARA International ASA, FarmWeather is a mobile app for farmers to track weather that could impact their crop growth and the processes on the farm. It tracks crop-specific rainfall, temperature and wind for up to 7 days in advance. It helps farmers make informed decisions with the ability to view rainfall amounts for the past 30 days and predictions for the next 15 days. The FarmWeather app uses historical weather data and latest satellite data to create forecast models and soil quality analysis and makes it available to farmers.

records.title: FarmForce Origin (traceability)
records.description: Farmforce Origin is a cloud-hosted web and mobile platform enabling transparency and digital management in the first mile of agricultural value chains. This traceability solution has a digital farmer database in which field staff register each farmer, together with their photo and GPS-mapped polygons of their individual fields. Each one is assigned a unique ID number for traceability purposes. Family members can also be linked to individual farmers, including relatives and children, which helps MNCs, NGOs, and cooperatives tackle social issues such as child labor in the food supply chain. The solution is deployed in Thailand, China, India, Indonesia and Viet Nam. It is a Business to business solution providing services such as Supply Chain Management through Mobile applications, Social Media using technologies like Data analytics & Business Intelligence, Field sensors and diagnostics equipment (e.g. farm field, livestock, agricultural machinery sensors, portable soil/crop testing tools), Remote sensing.

records.title: TOCA Platform
records.description: Developed by MULBERRYSOFT, the TOCA Platform is digital solution that offers upstream management (organic farming), trading management (E-commerce: B2B, B2C), engagement opportunity between entrepreneurs and consumers and data collection and analytic. The system allows farmer's access to recording data, managing conversions, planing production, calculating costs, connecting sales to create confidence for consumers. records.title: Farm Man Yum Service (Smart Farmer)
records.description: Developed jointly by DTAC, Samnuek Rak Ban Kerd Co., Ltd. (RBK) and Ricult (Thailand) Co., Ltd., the Farm Man Yum Service (Smart Farmer) focuses on precise and personalized weather forecasting and allows farmers to manage their cultivation effectively. Ricult applies satellite imagery and Machine Learning to process weather forecasting. It has 3 key features which are 1) Personalized weather forecast that allows users to get the weather customized for their specific land, not just a district or province and which includes temperatures, probability of precipitation, and rainfall amount. It also displays the rain forecast for the next 7 days 2) Satellite imagery enables farmers to monitor their crop health and helps with early detection of such problems as nutrient deficiencies, pests and disease, allowing users to actively mitigate risks and manage their fields in a timely manner to protect yields 3) Crop advice helps farmer better plan ahead by providing tips and knowledge through infographics. A notification system helps farmers plan each crop from pre-cultivation to harvest. The service currently covers 7 types of crops and will be further expanded in the future.

_annotations.Name of supplier/developer: Samnuek Rak Ban Kerd Co., Ltd. (RBK) and Ricult (Thailand) Co., Ltd.
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
In 2018, dtac and partners tested the Farm Man Yum service with 25 maize and cassava farmers on a total growing area about 1,000 rai in Saraburi and Lop Buri provinces. Results from using the Farm Man Yum were:  i) ncreased yields of 400 kilograms per rai; ii) Reduced crop damage by 44%; iii) Increased income of 2,520 baht per rai.

Source: Developer website

records.title: Varuna Smart Forest
records.description: Developed by Varuna (Thailand) Co., Ltd., Varuna Smart Forest is a digital solution which uses multispectral drone, satellite and Varuna Analytics platform to manage green areas and monitor changes of natural resources and environment in Thailand. This solution uses 1) Unmanned aerial vehicle or multispectral drone which improves work efficiency in particular, reducing the time spent on surveying the area by 10 times, reducing the cost and risk of using human labor in the field operations and 2) Satellite images to monitor and analyze large green areas at a high angle to suggest how this green area can be managed. Including how much carbon absorption in plants or forests can be collected. It helps in green area management and planning which contributes to the emission of greenhouse gases and increase the absorption of greenhouse gases where the results from the data were analyzed to assist operator decision-making process.

records.title: Spsmartplants
records.description: SPsmartplants is a plant management system that uses Internet of Things (IoT) devices to manage planting based on the characteristics and needs of each plant, making it easier for farmers and growers to grow or maintain their garden. The solution also allows farmers and growers to access their garden data anytime, anywhere. It's main features include 1) SMART IRRIGATION SYSTEM which is an automatic watering control system connected to Smart Box devices 2) SMART DEVICES SYSTEM is an electrical equipment control system related to plant cultivation, such as water pumps, solenoid valves, ventilation fans, plant growing lights, greenhouse sunshades, etc., which are also controlled via internet network signals 3) SMART SENSORS connected to various sensors to measure important values ​​for plants or produce, such as air temperature, air/soil humidity, pH/EC in water, PPFD light intensity and quantity 4) ONLINE / OFFLINE STATION works through the Internet network signal including LAN, WiFi and 3G and also works offline 5) CROP PROFILE tells how to plant or take care of a particular crop in detail and 6) DATA REPORT stores and displays the machine's operating data by storing the date of use, start and end times, and the duration of each operation, along with storing numerical values ​​from various sensor devices.

records.title: GeoPfes
records.description: GeoPfes is an Android application developed by the Institute of Forest Ecology and Environment - Vietnam Forestry University which supports the monitoring and evaluation of forest environmental services in Vietnam. It helps in conducting field surveys and assessments for experiments related to forest resource management and silviculture design. It enables local authorities to promptly update forest changes, monitor forest status through satellite imagery, and accurately collect data to effectively oversee forest development. GeoPfes is a tool for researchers, forest managers, and environmental professionals who are involved in monitoring and evaluating the environmental services provided by forests in Vietnam. It offers a convenient and reliable way to gather data and generate reports, helping to improve the understanding and management of forest ecosystems.

records.title: FindPlant
records.description: Developed by iKong Vietnam, FindPlant is a mobile app based digital solution for plant identification and garden monitoring. It allows users to identify plants through photos and also allows users to plan garden activities, explore plant traits, get plant care tips, and weather-related notifications. The mobile application is available on Android and iOS platforms. The main features of solution include 1) Accurate Plant Identification: Identify plants using a photo or by entering details about the plant's size, shape, color, and other features. records.description: AgUnity is a blockchain based mobile app that allows farmers to record their work, perform farm-focused transactions, cooperate with other farmers and take their crop to market. records.title: Sat4Rice
records.description: Developed by Nelen & Schuurmans Ltd., Sat4Rice is a real-time growth monitoring system which uses a combination of satellite data and field data to provide both actionable advice to smallholder farmers and business intelligence information to agribusinesses. It provides accurate insights on rice growing conditions which provides farmers, extension workers and traders with valuable information that helps them become more efficient. The app allows data to be entered from the field, which integrated with satellite data in real-time. The resulting information in the database is then used both in the smartphone app for farmers, and in the professional desktop portal for agribusinesses. The first successful implementation of Sat4Rice was in the Mekong delta in Vietnam, where over 50,000 smallholder farmers have been reached with the service. Sat4Rice is also being implemented in Pakistan, and collaborations in other South East Asian countries have started up as well.

records.title: Alesca Platform
records.description: Alesca Life is an agricultural technology company that builds turnkey vertical farms and precision agriculture solutions to maximize farm productivity and efficiency. Alesca democratizes access to fresh and nutritious food by democratizing the means and knowledge of production. It has 4 major digital solutions 1) Alesca Cloud is a web and smartphone-based operations and supply chain management system which organizes all daily tasks, tracks all production, and provides insights through customizable dashboards 2) The Alesca Container Farm is a turnkey precision farming solution for commercial scale food production. This all-in-one system is loaded with advanced monitoring, automation, and climate control capabilities 3) The Alesca Fresh Indoor Farm is a compact cabinet farm for on-site food production. This energy and water efficient system is fully automated and optimized for microgreen and leafy green production and 4) Alesca Sprout is an environmental monitoring and automation system for hydroponic farming operations. This sensor-based control box automates dosing, irrigation, and other farm electrical equipment.

_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
The platform helps in farms become most energy efficient by 30-60% lower Capital Expenses per kilogram in comparison to global vertical farming projects. On top of that, Alesca facility has 10-20% lower Operating Expenses per kilogram compared to other farms in Japan. 

Source: https://www.verticalfarmdaily.com/article/9622987/japan-vertical-farm-launched-which-operates-on-30-60-lower-capex-than-other-farms/

records.title: FarmAI
records.description: Developed by ListenField Inc., FarmAI is a web and mobile app based solution which digitizes and measures fields, reduces paper work through digital activity logging, and provides users with relevant weather information and advice, at the field level. FarmAI also supports collaboration among members of farming communities: farmers can invite their fellow farmers to work in their farm, or join a cooperative or an organization to get timely and relevant farming advice. The main services of this solution are 1) Near real-time Soil Nutrition Analysis - Farmers can evaluate soil conditions in real-time, allowing them to optimize fertilizer use from land preparation 2) Climate risk assessment - Scenario-based climate analysis including historical weather data to help users understand how different weather scenarios affect yields, and the potential consequences of planting outside the optimum windows 3) Crop health monitoring - Detailed and up-to-date views of crop conditions to help identify symptoms (water stress) before damages occur, as well as optimize harvesting plans (identify when and where to harvest). This can significantly maximize crop yields and reduce costs 4) Product Traceability - Captures essential data such as farm locations, production activity logs, and expected and actual production and 5) GHG Emission Monitoring, Reporting, and Validation (MRV): Analysis services suitable for GHG Emission Monitoring, Reporting, and Validation (MRV) which uses remote sensing and machine learning algorithms to monitor GHG Emissions from rice production, including emissions from soil, fertilizer, and crop management practices.

_annotations.Digital Solution Type (Category & sub-ca: Digital Agriculture :: AI-Big data based solutions
_annotations.Measurable positive impact(s) by Digital:
By digitizing the whole production process, FarmAI connects cooperatives, farmer groups, agribusinesses, and agronomists, effectively creating an ecosystem that provides numerous benefits.

First, FarmAI provides near-real-time soil health and climate risk insights to farmers, which enables them to reduce inefficiencies that contribute to low productivity, improve yields per hectare, and reduce operational costs. By applying best practices on fertilizer and water management using precise information, farmers can reduce fertilizer input costs and improve their yields. If successfully executed in Thailand, the economic impact can be worth $4.2 billion by 2030. In Southeast Asian countries, the economic impact can be worth $7.7 billion and $1.6 billion by 2050.

Second, FarmAI promotes a sustainable and climate-resilient food production ecosystem where biodiversity is maintained and farmer capacities are enhanced, thereby enhancing farmer competitiveness, resilience, and innovation. This inclusive ecosystem can spur increased investments, job creation, and enhance international cooperation to further develop rural infrastructures, agricultural innovation, and intensify extension services in Thailand and other Southeast Asian countries. Rice cultivation alone can help generate as much as 40 million jobs by 2030.

Third, FarmAI promotes supply chain efficiency for food and agribusinesses by promoting a digital ecosystem. Stakeholders gain insights at various points in the production process, enabling the identification of inefficiencies to manage resources more effectively. The rural supply chain effectively works as a cohesive whole where higher performance is achieved at reduced cost.

Finally, FarmAI contributes to regenerating the planet through enhanced data collection and integration. Stakeholders can have a better view of the rice production supply chain and leverage data to gain a deeper understanding of elements that impact both rice production and GHG emissions. Experts can use this data to develop policies that directly mitigate GHG emissions, such as subsidies for Nitrogen inhibitors for sustainable fertilizer use, or drought-resistant rice varieties to increase water savings.

Source: https://solve.mit.edu/challenges/climate-adaptation-challenge/solutions/71899

records.title: Farmers Support
records.description: Farmers Support is a Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IoT) based predictive delivery systems for cattle farms. It uses an IoT and AI-enabled camera system that collects and analyzes the image of a cow and notifies the owner if it detects any delivery signs. The collected data can be accessed via mobile phones, computers, and tablets. The solution has 2 main components 1) Delivery sign detection system: When the AI ​​detects the exposure of the amniotic sac, the violent raising of the tail, or the exposure of the calf's hooves, it notifies the user along with an image and 2) Estrus Detection System: When the AI ​​detects riding behavior , it notifies users with a picture. It is the first completely non-contact estrus detection system in Japan (according to Waseda University, Japan research).

records.title: GoField
records.description: Developed by Goanna Ag, GoField is a web and mobile app based solution which provides intelligent and accurate irrigation scheduling to farmers. It is a comprehensive approach to managing irrigation scheduling, integrating in-field sensors, local weather data, crop growth stage and satellite imagery and then applies deeply researched analytics to identify the optimum time for irrigation. Not only farmers can monitor and manage this in real-time, but GoField provides an accurate 7-day forecast allowing it's users to proactively manage their water resources. GoField is an advanced water-saving irrigation scheduling solution designed to transform agriculture. It begins by compiling an extensive, field-specific dataset, tailored to your agricultural situation. This dataset serves as the foundation for understanding the dynamic conditions of your soil and the performance of your crops.

records.title: TeleSense
records.description: TeleSense is a sensors technology based mobile app solution for monitoring of agricultural commodities to improve storage life and increase profitability with continuous remote monitoring. During storage, grain may spoil due to several factors such as excessive moisture, mold, and insects. By combining TeleSense sensors with data science capabilities, the solution simplify grain quality management in storage. The sensors continuously monitor temperature, relative humidity (RH), carbon dioxide and transmit the data to the TeleSense app. It provides info on improving grain storage life, reduce spoilage, when to turn fans on/off and when to sell.

records.title: Regrow (FluroSat)
records.description: FluroSat is an Internet of Things (IoT) based crop health decision support and analytics solution. It's a unique science and technology mix with the ability to combine renown academic crop science with remote sensing and farm data to provide science-based decision support and full-cycle agricultural field monitoring (pre-, in- and post-season). It supports a range of crops from grains, legumes, oilseed, to speciality crops and perennials. FluroSat solves many challenges being faced by the agriculture sector by 1) Integrating a wide range of ag data layers (satellite/aerial/drone imagery, machinery "as-applied" files, IoT/ soil info, weather, etc) 2) Scientific modelling (agriculture crop models calibrated by local universities) to support a range of management decisions around nutrient, crop stress, and crop performance management etc 3) Outputs automatically derived actionable crop metrics, recommendations, maps in a range of popular formats (machinery shapefiles, push notifications into mot popular farm management systems: Proagrica, Agrian, Agworld, Climate FieldView).

records.title: eShepherd
records.description: Developed by Gallagher Group Limited, eShepherd is a virtual shepherd and Internet of Things (IoT) baseddigital solution which enables farmers to fence, move, or monitor their beef or dairy cattle using their smartphone. Animals wear a collar connected to a farmer’s phone or tablet via a wireless base station. The collar uses a patented CSIRO algorithm to train the animals to move or stay within a geo fence virtual boundary. Called “eShepherd", this solution enables farmers to control livestock grazing to increase production through more efficient pasture utilization, improved animal health and welfare, while reducing the cost of fencing, labour and mustering. eShepherd improves sustainability avoiding overgrazing, and providing a wildlife friendly tool to manage stock damage to waterways and national parks.

records.title: Recirculated Aquaculture System (RAS)
records.description: Aquacultur is a Internet of Things (IoT) and sensors based digital solution for aquaculture. RAS is aelf-contained, tank-based system. It recycles water allowing for an Indoor recirculating aquaculture  and fish to be grown under controlled environmental conditions in water. Recycling is done through biological and mechanical filters, with minimal waste exchanged back into the environment and a low volume of water required per unit of production.  Aquacultur’s modular Recirculated Aquaculture System (RAS) provides a closed-loop method of farming fish in freshwater pods where water is purified & reused continuously. This reduces water & energy consumption, land footprint, and environmental impact in comparison with traditional aquaculture.

records.title: Weather and Networked Data (WAND)
records.description: Developed by Goanna Ag, WAND is a spray drift hazardous weather warning system that provides real-time weather data for growers and spray operators about the presence or absence of hazardous temperature inversions. It consists of a world-first network of 101 profiling inversion towers located across the grain and cotton regions of New South Wales and Queensland. The inversion towers have remote sensing capability and new proprietary software to provide growers and spray contractors with a two-hour forecast of real-time weather data that is updated every 10 minutes. This data can accurately identify whether a hazardous inversion or hazardous conditions are present, allowing farmers to understand whether they can spray or not against their label requirements. This information reduces the spray drift risk for growers and spray contractors.

records.title: Agristry
records.description: Agristry is a ag-tech startup which offers precision agriculture based crop mapping, weed mapping and land mapping solutions for farmers. It enables crop mapping through drone imagery analysis and plant indices and creates crop health maps and monitors field development over the season. It identifies patterns to generate diagnostic maps that are downloadable as shapefiles for machinery. It uses computer vision, Artificial Intelligence (AI) and spatial tech to provide valuable insights on plant count, harvest readiness of crops, stress detection, and more. Agristry also creates weed maps that accurately display the location of infested areas so that farmers are able to tackle weeds before they pose a serious threat. In addition, Agristry offers 3D land survey models to analyze the terrain.

records.title: Farmo
records.description: Australian startup Farmo provides Internet of Things (IoT) solutions for farm monitoring leveraging LoRaWAN and NB-IoT technology. Its digital solutions include the Water Rat, a tank and trough sensor that offers real-time water level monitoring. Also, its Water Tank Level Monitor allows users to monitor tank levels frequently, ensuring timely water supply management. Another digital solution, the Electric Fence Sensor, sends alerts when fence voltage drops, ensuring livestock containment. Farmo’s Gate Sensor detects metal drop-latch in the closed position, which eliminates the problems of false alerts caused by wind or animals rubbing on the gate.

records.title: Farmable PRO
records.description: Farmable PRO is a mobile app based digital solution which reinvents how tree crop growers gather, organise and use their data, helping them to improve yields while taking care of the environment. It enables tree crop growers to track, monitor and record operations via a mobile app. Data is gathered in the field and manually entered into the app, giving orchard managers a real-time overview of activities. With this data, the farmers can make sound decisions to enhance productivity and efficiency. The app also generates a database of records to simplify reporting to authorities and marketing organisations. The Farmable PRO app tracks orchard inputs down to the row level, giving growers more precise control of water, energy, fertiliser and pesticides.

Growers use less water and energy, as well as less fertiliser and pesticides, reducing potentially harmful runoff. In addition, human resources and logistics are optimised, eliminating unnecessary use of energy-consuming vehicles and equipment.

records.title: Farmnote
records.description: Farmote is a digital solution which combines data from satellites in space and Motes on the ground, provides precise daily pasture measurements and invaluable insights through a mobile-friendly web platform. It works by collecting data from remote monitoring devices called ‘Motes’ installed at selected locations throughout farmers paddocks. The sensors contained within the Motes capture pasture measurements and soil conditions that are cross-referenced with multispectral images taken by satellites, and then uploaded to Farmnote's website. The pasture growth data collected daily, using accurate remote monitoring devices in paddocks, with multispectral images taken by satellites.

records.description: Developed by FutureLab Ltd., Mussel app is a data driven aquaculture farming solution which automates farms to enhance yield and boost performance. records.title: Water To Milk
records.description: Water To Milk is an Internet of Things (IoT) and mobile app based water management system for dairy farms. It allow dairy farms to build a full picture of how water is used across the farm, from water take to cattle troughs, irrigation to effluent ponds. It features locally made IoT technology built to last on New Zealand dairy farms, connected with common-sense software. They combine to deliver practical insights that get maximum value out of farmer's precious water resource while meeting their environmental goals as steward of their land. The main app elements include 1)  delivering a holistic view of the water volume on a farm, with a network of sensors reporting a farm’s water take, dam level and tank level, along with forecast and actual rainfall 2) Irrigation Management helps farmers take control of their irrigation with remote oversight of their entire system 3) remote monitoring to the dairy shed and across the farm. It's solar powered sensors remotely monitor soil moisture, rainfall, and nitrates in their waterways so farmers can lower the risk of nutrient drainage and discover the impact of their efforts to maintain waterway quality.

records.title: WxOutside
records.description: Developed by WxAdvisory Limited., WxOutside is a sensors, web dashboard and mobile app based solution for forecasting soil moisture and temperature. It can detect irrigation, handle unexpected weather events with ease, identify the field capacity and wilting point, and is accurate to within 99.5% of the final reading. records.description: COGNITIVE AGRO PILOT is an Artificial Intelligence (AI) based crop harvesting solution which helps splitting driving and control of harvesting equipment between robot mode and a human operator by providing analysis of yield maps and harvesting modes for next-season planning. It also helps in reduction in mechanical incidents and protection of hardware for a longer service life resulting in up to 5% reduction in fuel consumption during harvesting. The main features of include 1) Real-time analysis of harvested crop with instant evaluation of impurity content, moisture, and other crop quality parameters 2) Provides recommendations on preferable harvesting machine settings and compliance analysis 3) Analysis of harvester operator statistics (operators’ individual performance) and 4) Keeps the machinery in good condition by eliminating the human factor from the process.

records.title: AgroMon
records.description: AgroMon is a mobile app and web based digital solution for farm management. It helps monitor crop health, manage operations and share the data with farm team and advisors resulting in entire crop cycle more efficient — including season planning, operation management, field scouting, collaboration with advisors and post-harvest analytics. Main functions include 1) Electronic map of fields 2) Agroscouting which lets users take photos on the field with georeferencing, easily select the growing season and problems from the reference books, issue recommendations, share the survey with colleagues 3) History - sowing, soil preparation, fertilization, plant protection, harvesting 4) Agronomic directories - catalogs of weeds, diseases and pests will help identify the problem; hybrids, preparations and fertilizers - get information on the desired product and 5) Help of consultants - specialists from companies supplying plant protection products, seeds and fertilizers can work in the system together farmers and farm managers.

records.title: e-RNR Crop Advisory
records.description: Developed jointly by  jointly developed by the Ministry of Agriculture and Forests, Royal Government of Bhutan and Sunrise Computer Software Pvt. Ltd, India, the e-RNR Crop Advisory is a mobile app targeted to help our youths to start farming and urban dwellers take up kitchen gardening. It's a repository of instructions on agricultural practices and instructions on how to grow particular crops and general agricultural practices. It also has links to weather forecasts and agriculture related news. The information is shared through text, pictorial and video messages. The app provides technical-know-how on growing various crops starting from nursery management to harvesting. It also provides video tutorials with farming tips, displayes crop calendars with information on planting, sowing and harvesting regarding various agro-ecological zones. The app also has links to various agriculture commodities market price information.

records.title: SIBJAM
records.description: Sibjam is Bhutanese local startup which has developed an online marketplace for farmers to sell their products and for buyers to purchase local products at wholesale rates. It offers marketing and logistical services to farmers, allowing them to focus on production, and freeing up their time and resources from supply-chain issues. Sibjam ensures an effective logistic linkage between the farmers and consumers to reduce waste of farm produce and to eliminate the middleman. The platform has 1500+ farmers, 200+ products which are 100% local.
